title: Mid/Senior Automation Test (Tester, Automation QA)
company: Saafehouse
description:
## Company

Saafehouse is a fintech company that builds software for secure cash, asset, and client-money operations. Its platform supports reconciliations, approvals, payments, reporting, document management, and integrations for developed financial markets.

## Details

- **Location:** Da Nang, Vietnam (Saafehouse VN office)
- **Seniority/Level:** Mid/Senior (Senior QA Automation Engineer)
- **Work model:** Hybrid

## Responsibilities

- Implement internal QA workflows that work alongside the engineering partner, then gradually build a reliable automated testing pipeline.
- Define a practical automation strategy, select the right E2E framework, and establish maintainable standards.
- Prioritise and automate critical user journeys while retaining exploratory and manual testing where it adds value.
- Integrate reliable automated testing into CI/CD to improve release confidence and feedback speed.
- Own the approach to test environments, test data, failure diagnosis, and automation stability.
- Partner with developers, QA, the Product Owner, and the Head of Engineering to improve quality across the delivery lifecycle.
- Remain hands-on while mentoring junior QA engineers, sharing knowledge, and distributing work effectively.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Strong experience testing production web applications and building maintainable automation suites.
- Strong practical experience with a modern E2E testing framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
- Good understanding of test strategy, the test pyramid, and the roles of unit, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD, including fast smoke checks and broader regression coverage.
- Experience managing test data, environment dependencies, and independent test execution.
- A systematic approach to diagnosing flaky tests, asynchronous behaviour, dynamic UI elements, and backend or environment failures.
- The judgement to prioritise business-critical flows and stable coverage before over-engineering the framework.
- Strong exploratory-testing skills and the ability to turn product risks and manual knowledge into clear, reusable test cases.
- Clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate with developers, QA, product colleagues, and external partners.
- Experience mentoring junior team members and helping them contribute independently.
- Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to work directly with UK leadership.
- Familiarity with modern web technologies, relational databases, AWS cloud services, and Git/GitHub is helpful. Strong experience with a comparable modern stack and the ability to learn an existing system quickly are valued over experience with every tool.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience in fintech or another regulated environment.
- Experience with API testing and data validation.
- Experience testing multi-tenant products.
- Experience in a vendor-to-in-house transition or working alongside an outsourced engineering partner.

## Benefits

- Attractive salary.
- 13th-month salary.
- Performance bonus.
- 20 days of paid annual leave and 7 days of paid sick leave.
- Statutory social, health, and unemployment insurance co-contributions based on full gross salary, subject to Vietnamese law.
- Premium healthcare.
- Extra benefits recognising work anniversaries.
- Hybrid working at the Saafehouse VN office in Da Nang.
- Training and education support for relevant technical, security, and financial-services development.
- Significant career and personal-development opportunities as the Vietnam engineering organisation grows.
- Direct learning opportunities from the UK fintech founder and Head of Engineering.
- Free drinks and snacks in the office.

title: Senior Pentester (Red Team, Python, PowerShell, Tester)
company: ABBANK
description:
## Company

ABBANK is a Vietnamese commercial bank.

## Details

- **Location:** Ha Noi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

- Design, manage, and coordinate penetration testing campaigns across the entire system, including web, mobile, API, cloud, and Active Directory.
- Conduct Red Team and adversary simulation exercises that emulate real-world APT attacks.
- Analyze and exploit 0-day vulnerabilities and logic flaws.
- Research, develop, and maintain scripts and tools that automate repeatable steps in the attack chain, including reconnaissance, initial access, persistence, lateral movement, and exfiltration.
- Build automated pipelines and frameworks that deploy attack simulation scenarios quickly and at scale, replacing manual, step-by-step execution.
- Customize and extend existing C2 tools such as Cobalt Strike and Outflank using self-written scripts and modules (e.g., Aggressor Scripts, BOFs) to shorten campaign setup time.
- Automate payload generation and obfuscation, and self-test detection risk (AV/EDR bypass testing) before real-world deployment.
- Build internal tools that compile and standardize Red Team reporting, reducing manual report-writing time.
- Maintain and update an automated library of TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures), mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
- Work with the SOC to automate Purple Team scenarios, including triggering simulated attacks automatically and automatically comparing detection results.
- Develop AI-based scenarios within Red Team operations, and Red Team exercises targeting AI systems.
- Provide internal training and conduct periodic assessments of the testing team's capabilities.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education**
- Bachelor's or master's degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or Computer Science.

**Knowledge**
- In-depth understanding of Information Technology.
- In-depth understanding of Information Security.
- In-depth understanding of secure software development.
- Deep knowledge of penetration testing, including the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the Cyber Kill Chain.
- Proficiency with specialized tools such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, BloodHound, and Mimikatz.
- Thorough understanding of attack vectors, including Active Directory attacks, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and C2 (Command and Control).
- Knowledge of AI: ability to tailor AI-driven Red Team scenarios to business objectives.
- Coding experience in Python, PowerShell, Go, or C/C++ to build tools and scripts for attack simulation and process automation.
- "Automation-first" mindset: proactively seeks to reduce manual work and to increase the repeatability and scalability of campaigns.

**Experience**
- At least 5 years of experience in IT, including at least 3 years in penetration testing.
- Advanced certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, CRTP, CRTE, PNPT, or eCPTX are a plus.
- Hands-on experience in complex environments such as banks, government agencies, or large enterprises.
- Experience in forensic analysis, memory dump analysis, or malware reverse engineering is a plus.
- Understanding of CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) to automate the provisioning and teardown of attack infrastructure for each campaign.
- Experience automating evasion testing, such as bulk AV/EDR bypass testing without manual handling of each sample.
- Ability to automate the collection and analysis of reconnaissance data (OSINT automation).

## Benefits

- Competitive salary that reflects the candidate's skills and experience (details to be discussed during the interview).
- 13 days of flexible annual leave, including birthday leave and other special occasions.
- Full social insurance in accordance with labor law, plus ABBANK CARE, a supplementary benefits program for ABBANK employees.
- Preferential loan interest rates for ABBANK employees.
- Opportunities to join large-scale digital transformation projects and work alongside

description:

- Kubernetes.
- Messaging and asynchronous systems (SQS, EventBridge).

- Responsible and proactive: takes ownership of tasks and sees them through to completion; considers blast radius and safety when changing infrastructure.

## Benefits

- Social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese labor law.
- A dynamic startup environment that values initiative, empowerment, and experimenting with new ideas.
- Opportunities to work on a variety of projects, from internal products to products for Japanese clients, and to broaden business knowledge and hands-on experience.
- Access to a range of AWS services, infrastructure patterns, and technology stacks suited to each problem, without being confined to one technology or fixed role.

- Direct work with Japanese clients, learning Japanese-standard processes and work culture.
- A career path toward Senior, Platform Lead, or Tech Lead, with mentoring, internal training, and knowledge-sharing opportunities.

  - Monitoring systems and detecting anomalies and incidents early.

  - Performing root cause analysis (RCA) and implementing measures to prevent recurrence.

**1. 24/7 Incident Monitoring & Response**

- Take part in 24/7 incident response and on-call operations.

- Receive, classify, and assess the severity and impact scope of incidents.

description:
## Company

Amanotes is a mobile game company that develops and publishes music games. Since 2014 it has released titles including Magic Tiles 3, Tiles Hop, Dancing Road, and Duet Cats, which have been downloaded across more than 190 countries.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Not specified
- **Work model:** On-site (at office)

## Responsibilities

The Analytics Engineer will bridge the gap between the raw data pipelines built by Data Engineering and the analytical and operational needs of Product Managers, LiveOps, User Acquisition (UA), and Leadership. The role involves transforming complex, high-volume player behavioral telemetry and business data into clean, well-documented, tested, and standardized dimensional models. The role also includes pioneering the development of the company's "insight stack," which maps data models and business questions into Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and AI agent workflows to turn raw telemetry into reliable, automated, self-serve business insights.

### 1. Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Architecture & Maintenance

- Design, build, and maintain production-grade dimensional data models in Google BigQuery using dbt, standardizing core metrics (UA, ad monetization, IAP, player engagement, and retention) into a trusted single source of truth.
- Own and evolve the enterprise semantic layer across BI platforms (e.g., Metabase) and AI agent endpoints, preventing metric drift through clear versioning, deprecation policies, and canonical definitions.
- Maintain model health, cost, and query performance: optimize BigQuery execution (partitioning, clustering, incremental builds) while ensuring data freshness SLAs and anomaly monitoring.
- Enforce software engineering rigor across analytics: modular dbt development, automated CI/CD testing, Git version control, and peer code reviews.

### 2. Insight Stack & AI-Powered Decision Infrastructure

- Collaborate with data leadership to design and evolve the "insight stack," connecting structured data assets to AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools.
- Translate recurring stakeholder decision flows (across Product, LiveOps, UA, and Management) into standardized inputs, queries, validation rules, and structured outputs for automated agent execution.
- Build tool schemas, prompts, and execution flows enabling AI agents to query verified datasets, run comparative checks, and draft decision-ready summaries.
- Establish guardrails, data validation, and permission boundaries ensuring AI agents operate safely without unmonitored raw database access.

### 3. Data Quality, Testing & Verification

- Establish comprehensive automated testing frameworks (dbt tests, schema validation, data integrity rules) to safeguard data reliability and timeliness across all core data marts.
- Define evaluation criteria and test suites to benchmark AI agent outputs against ground-truth queries, dashboards, and analyst outputs.
- Build alerting and monitoring systems for data discrepancies, silent schema drift, and telemetry anomalies, driving swift incident resolution.
- Document assumptions, data lineage, edge cases, and handoff criteria between automated agent analysis and human analyst

## Company

- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

This role leads quality assurance for a re-platforming project for a national public-sector system in the EU. The legacy system, about 750 screens of a client-server 4GL application (Uniface), is being rebuilt as a modern Java/Spring and React application on an Oracle database. The central question is whether the new system does exactly what the old one does. Each migration wave must meet that bar before going live. Because the scope includes thousands of business rules, verification must be automated and repeatable, so the QA lead will build the test system that compares old and new behavior on every wave. That system does not exist yet and will be built in this role.

- Design the test architecture and set up an AI-driven workflow that turns business rules into executable tests at scale.
- Lead two QA/BA engineers who work within the test system.
- Make the go / no-go decision for every migration wave.
- Work from the specification owned by the BA Lead, and return it when it is not testable.
- Test each migration wave against the legacy system and verify that the new system behaves as expected.
- Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory tests.
- Create detailed test cases and test scenarios based on business requirements and specifications.
- Investigate the legacy application to understand existing workflows, validations, and business rules.
- Compare old and new system behavior and identify functional differences.
- Check data directly in Oracle using SQL to verify that records and business results are correct.
- Report defects clearly, including steps to reproduce, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
- Retest fixes and perform regression testing before releases.
- Support UAT with the client, including test scenario preparation, execution, and issue tracking.
- Work closely with developers and BA team members to analyze and resolve defects.
- Contribute to the automated regression suite and gradually expand automation coverage.
- Maintain test documentation and ensure adequate coverage for each migration wave.
- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to support test case creation, test analysis, documentation, and repetitive QA activities.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in QA/testing, preferably on business-critical or enterprise applications.
- Strong understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and QA processes.
- Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into meaningful test scenarios and test cases.
- Experience with functional and regression testing of web or business applications.
- Good SQL skills and the ability to independently verify data in a relational database.
- Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to investigating issues.
- Ability to understand complex business processes and identify missing or unclear requirements.
- Experience using Jira / Confluence and test management tools such as Xray, TestRail, or similar.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with developers, BAs, and business stakeholders.
- Fluent English.
- Comfortable working AI-first and using AI tools regularly to improve productivity and testing quality.
- Skills: Java, Selenium, and automation testing.

Nice to have:

- Experience with test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar.
- API testing experience with REST / Postman / Newman, or similar.
- Basic scripting or programming knowledge.

title: Senior QA Manager (QA/QC, Tester, English)
company: Nakivo
description:
## Company

NAKIVO is a software company that develops backup, replication, and disaster recovery products for virtualized and on-premises IT environments. Its products are deployed in more than 30,000 customer environments.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Level:** Senior / Manager (leads QA leads and the QA organization)
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

- Own QA delivery and performance across twelve product lines and the automation and performance functions.
- Develop five team leads: set goals, hold one-to-ones, make performance decisions, and handle hiring. Two of them will be new hires you inherit within their first months.
- Own your teams' targets against the organization's QA scorecard. Set them, review them per team, and hit them. Focus on quality outcomes, not case counts.
- Own how QA works day to day within the release train model: defect lifecycle, test execution, triage, estimation and self-estimation, review discipline, and reporting. Argue for changes to the model itself. The VP owns the model.
- Build specification review and estimation capability in your leads until area-level scoping no longer routes through the VP.
- Raise automation share and throughput per engineer. Make testing cycles faster without sacrificing coverage or confidence.
- Own QA's side of escaped defect analysis. Every customer escape should lead to a change in what QA does. Partner with Support on recurring and high-impact issues and feed the patterns back across all teams.
- Work with Product and Development to review requirements through a customer-impact lens. Improve defect prevention, not just detection.
- Prepare the quarterly business review and co-present your teams' numbers with the VP, who owns the QA story told to the executive team.
- Prepare the quality evidence the VP needs for release go/no-go decisions. You do not make the ship call.
- This is not a hands-on testing role. Expect under 10% hands-on work: enough to maintain technical credibility with your leads, but not enough to do their jobs. You will be judged on what your six people and their teams produce.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Required:**

- 8 or more years in software quality assurance, including 3 or more years managing managers or team leads (not only engineers) in a software product organization.
- A track record of raising a QA organization's output, with numbers: throughput per engineer, automation share, reduction in escaped defects, and cycle time. Experience building QA processes where none existed.
- An automation-first delivery approach and the ability to increase test volume rather than reduce it. The scale is roughly 1,000 test cases per feature, about 3,900 cases in the quarterly release train scope, and about 1,650 for the largest single product line. Describe how you would produce and manage this, for example through AI-assisted generation, templates, parallel execution, and risk prioritization.
- QA-side ownership of escaped defects: when a defect reaches a customer, you change what QA does, not only what Product and Development do.
- English strong enough to hold your own in front of the CEO. You will co-present the quarterly business review and negotiate with Product and Development leadership.
- Daily use of AI tools in your work (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, or Atlassian Rovo). You should be able to explain where AI fits in your workflow, what you review before trusting its output, and what you tried that did not work.
- Comfort being accountable for other people's teams, including hiring, performance decisions, and difficult calls, such as managing a senior technical specialist who knows the product better than you do.

**Desired:**

- Experience with enterprise or on-premises software shipped to environments you cannot access after release. A bad build cannot be fixed overnight.
- Experience working closely with Support or Customer Success on escaped-defect analysis.
- Familiarity with cloud storage platforms (such as AWS S3, Wasabi, or Azure) and hypervisors (such as VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox, or Nutanix).
- Experience with test management at scale, using Xray or similar tools.

## Benefits

- Flexible working hours; the office is open from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
- Private health care insurance and

- Establish, standardize, and continuously improve QA/QC processes under Agile/Scrum. Introduce testing early in requirements analysis (shift-left) and integrate testing into the CI/CD pipeline.
- Apply risk-based testing by identifying, assessing, and prioritizing areas of high business, technical, and data risk.
- Define quality metrics (Test Coverage, Defect Density, Defect Leakage, Pass/Fail rate, defect resolution time, etc.) and use them for decision-making.

**Test Team Management and Development**
- Directly manage manual and automation testers: estimate workload (Test Estimation), assign tasks, track progress, and resolve blockers.
- Review team members' test cases, test results, and defect reports to ensure consistent output that meets standards.
- Train, coach, and mentor team members, evaluate their performance, and build individual competency development plans.
- Build a shared team knowledge base with templates, checklists, sample test case sets, and guidance documents.

**Project Team Collaboration**
- Review requirements (User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, specifications) with BAs and POs from the start to catch ambiguities and gaps early.
- Work closely with Developers, DevOps, and Data/AI Engineers to agree on test scope, environments, data, and release plans.
- Represent QA in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives. Report quality status to PMs and leadership and give Go/No-Go recommendations before each release.

**Test Execution**
- Direct the design of test scenarios and test cases for functional and non-functional testing, including API, system integration, data, performance, security, and cross-platform compatibility (Web/Mobile).
- Prepare and manage test environments and test data, ensuring compliance with data security regulations.
- Manage the defect lifecycle in Jira: classify Severity and Priority, run Bug Triage, perform Root Cause Analysis, and track defects until closure.
- Drive test automation (API, UI, regression), gradually increasing the automation rate and shortening regression cycles.

**Applying AI to Testing (AI for Testing)**
- Use generative AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to generate test scenarios and test cases from User Stories and requirements, create synthetic test data, and support writing and maintaining automation scripts.
- Use AI to analyze logs and defect reports: group duplicate defects, suggest root causes, and predict high-risk areas to prioritize testing.

**Self-serve analytics**

- Experience doing analytics work through AI agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) is highly desirable. Experience building an analytics MCP server or semantic layer for LLM use is a further advantage. In either case, you should have the judgment to check an agent's output rather than trust it.
- Rigor and healthy skepticism: when numbers don't tie, you keep digging until you can explain the gap, and you are upfront about caveats and definitional choices instead of presenting one tidy number.

description:
## Company

Blogic Systems is a US-based company that builds point-of-sale (POS) systems for the restaurant and bar market in the United States. Its software runs live in restaurants across the US. The product team in Ho Chi Minh City works directly with the US-based team.

## Details

## Responsibilities

We are hiring for two levels: a **Fullstack Leader** to take charge of the technical direction and delivery of the fullstack team, and a **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to strengthen the team's core. The Leader role is a strategic position for someone with 6+ years of experience, including proven experience leading an engineering team. Strong Senior candidates without management experience are also encouraged to apply for the Senior track.

**1. Fullstack Development (both levels)**

- Design and implement robust, scalable, and high-performance server-side logic with .NET 8+ (and .NET Framework for legacy modules), exposing clean RESTful APIs.
- Build new features with Angular (v18+), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, following Clean Architecture and component-based design.
- Handle complex asynchronous data streams and state management with RxJS (switchMap, combineLatest, custom operators).
- Work with SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack (application code, SQL queries, frontend rendering) so the system handles high concurrent loads smoothly.
- Use CapacitorJS where applicable to share web code with the mobile apps.
- Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts (BAs), QA, Mobile, and POS teams to define clear API contracts and data models.

**2. Architecture & Quality Ownership**

- Contribute to system design and architectural decisions (Senior). Own the technical direction and architecture across the product line (Leader), applying Clean Architecture, DDD, or CQRS where the business logic calls for it.
- Treat business-critical flows (order submission, payment, surcharge/dual pricing, receipt printing, offline mode, and backward compatibility between POS versions) as production-critical. A one-cent discrepancy is an incident, not a minor bug.
- Own the quality of what you ship. Bugs found by customers, IT Support, or leadership, rather than by automated tests and code review, are your primary KPI (for the Leader, for the whole team).
- Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based services (AWS/Azure), with clear quality gates before anything reaches production.

**3. Team Leadership & Delivery (Leader track; Senior supports)**

- Lead, mentor, and develop the fullstack team. Set KPIs and career development plans for each member. Senior engineers mentor junior members through thorough code reviews.
- Define coding standards, testing practices, and best practices, and drive them across the team.
- Turn requirements from Product Owners and BAs into clear tasks, estimate and plan sprints, and manage priorities, risks, and delivery commitments across projects and releases.
- Coordinate with the QA, Mobile, and POS teams and with US-based stakeholders.
- Establish and enforce release readiness: nothing goes to production without meeting clear quality criteria. You have the authority to hold a release.
- Take part in hiring and onboarding, and build a collaborative, high-performing team.
- Stay hands-on by coding critical features, so your decisions stay grounded in the real codebase.

**4. AI-Driven Engineering**

- Use AI coding agents in daily work (code generation, refactoring, test writing, code review, debugging, documentation) to raise productivity, while owning the quality and security of everything you ship.
- Leader: define and roll out how the team works with AI, including agent roles and skills, a shared agent harness, verification loops, and AI code review in the pull-request flow.
- Stay up to date with .NET, Angular, and AI tooling, and share ideas on how to apply them in the company's products.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must have**

- **Experience:** 4+ years of professional experience in fullstack development, with a proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems. For the Leader track: 6+ years, including 2+ years leading a team or acting as a tech lead (required for Leader, a plus for Senior).
- Proficiency in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and Dapper. Strong understanding of OOP, SOL

title: Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer
company: Reclub Vietnam
description:
## Company

**Reclub Vietnam** operates Reclub, a social sports platform that helps people organize activities, discover communities, and play together. The platform aims to make recreational sports more accessible, social, and enjoyable.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City (The Sun Avenue, 28 Mai Chi Tho, Binh Trung Ward)
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior
- **Working time:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday
- **Work model:** Hybrid. Three onsite days shared with the engineering team. Releases and on-call are remote.

## Responsibilities

This role owns infrastructure, reliability, deployments, monitoring, and on-call. It is the company's first dedicated infrastructure hire. The platform is currently run part-time by the engineers who built it. It works, but parts of the estate are still manual, backups are not drill-tested enough, and access controls need tightening. The focus of this role is to close that gap: take ownership of production infrastructure, turn repeated manual work into code, improve operational safety, and build the runbooks and documentation the team can rely on.

Releases are currently attended and often happen outside business hours, with time shifted rather than added on top of a full working day. Part of the role is making releases safe enough to run during the day.

### Scope of Role

- Own production infrastructure across cloud environments, containers, networking, and self-hosted servers.
- Run deployments and improve CI/CD pipelines, staged releases, migrations, and rollbacks.
- Operate datastores, including backups, restores, replication, upgrades, and capacity planning.
- Own observability across metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerting.
- Carry primary on-call and build the runbooks, restore drills, escalation paths, and postmortem practices around it.
- Own security and access, including secrets management, patching, cloud and CI permissions, and least-privilege reviews.
- Replace repeated manual work with infrastructure as code.
- Manage infrastructure cost and capacity without compromising reliability.

### Key Success Indicators

- More infrastructure and access setup is documented, current, and managed as code.
- Backup, restore, and release processes are more reliable, better tested, and safer to run.
- On-call and incident response are more sustainable, with clearer alerts, stronger runbooks, and better follow-through on root causes.

## Requirements / Qualifications

### Must Have

**Professional expertise**

- 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering with real production ownership.
- Strong Linux fundamentals and confident shell scripting.
- Strong hands-on cloud experience, preferably AWS, across compute, networking, storage, and IAM.
- Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (a hard requirement) and CI/CD ownership.
- Production experience with containers and orchestration, such as ECS, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
- PostgreSQL operations experience, including replication, backups, restores, upgrades, and production migrations.
- Practical experience with secure remote access, VPN or zero-trust mesh networking, SSH access models, and firewall policy.
- Experience as primary on-call for a production system, handling real incidents calmly.
- Strong observability and alerting judgment, with the ability to design alerts people trust.

**Communication and documentation**

- Documentation-first mindset.
- Able to keep runbooks, architecture notes, access lists, and SOPs current.
- Able to turn operational knowledge into clear written standards the team can follow.

title: Junior Data Analyst (Python, SQL, R, Git)
company: AI+DI
description:
## Company

AI+DI builds measurement and certification infrastructure for human development outcomes, with the goal of making real improvements in people's lives verifiable and fundable. Its Data and Measurement team designs measurement instruments, processes data, validates results, and is responsible for the reliability of every figure the system produces. The current work centers on a measurement pilot for a mental health app.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Level:** Junior
- **Work model:** On-site (at office)

## Responsibilities

The pilot runs three data channels in parallel:
- **In-app diary:** events and state labels from app features, with no conversation content.
- **Random prompts:** check-ins at randomly drawn times, used to correct for bias from users choosing when to open the app.
- **Weekly questionnaires:** three instrument sets completed outside the app, including one international scale that does not yet have a validated Vietnamese version.

**1. Build and operate the measurement pipeline**
- Turn formula specifications into code that runs correctly and reproducibly: scoring questionnaires, computing indicators from diary data, and joining the three channels by time window.
- Write data quality checks at every step, covering required-field completeness, out-of-range values, time zone mismatches, late-arriving events, and duplicate records.
- Build recurring reports for the research team and for the organization. Figures reported to the organization must always be aggregated.
- Work with the app's engineering team on event contracts: identify missing fields, labels that are inconsistent across versions, and logs that are insufficient to compute the promised indicators.

**2. Analysis and statistical validation**
- Run pre-registered analyses, including multilevel models for data repeated over weeks, models for ordinal and categorical outcomes, time-to-event analysis with censored data, and causal analysis for repeated randomized experiments within the app.
- Validate measurement instruments: reliability, factor structure, stability across weeks, and agreement between machine-assigned labels and human-verified labels.
- Address unavoidable issues in this type of data: non-random missingness, self-selected measurement timing, small per-person sample sizes, and multiple comparisons.
- Run simulations to estimate sample sizes and to test the analysis methods themselves before real data is available.
- Write the methods and results sections, including an honest limitations section, for internal documentation and for independent verification partners.

**3. Data governance and evidence integrity**
- Enforce privacy rules in code, not only in documentation: minimum aggregation thresholds, protection against inferring hidden subgroups, and separation of identifying data from analysis data.
- Maintain provenance for every figure, from raw records to the final indicator, including the code version and data version that produced it.
- Contribute to pre-registration documents, and record every change made after registration in an append-only log.
- Detect and report cases requiring safety intervention according to the defined procedure, within the committed timeframe.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**1. Statistics**
- A solid foundation in statistical inference: understand what a test does and does not establish, distinguish statistical significance from effect size, and understand why confidence intervals are often more useful than p-values.
- Repeated-measures data over time: multilevel or mixed-effects models, separating within-person variation from between-person differences.
- Non-continuous outcomes: logistic regression, models for ordinal outcomes, and models for count data.
- Missing data: distinguish missingness mechanisms and understand how each affects conclusions.
- Measurement: reliability, validity, measurement error, and why a scale translated into another language must be re-validated before use.
- Causal reasoning at a conceptual level: know when it is appropriate to say "causes" versus only "is associated with."

**2. Technology**
- Proficiency in Python or R, sufficient to write pipelines rather than only running one-off analyses in notebooks. Strong candidates are comfortable with both.
- SQL at a level sufficient to write queries across multiple tables, use window functions, and handle timestamped data.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
company: Everfit
description:
## Company

Everfit is a fitness coaching platform that provides an all-in-one, AI-powered platform for coaches to run and grow their businesses. It operates in the health and wellness B2B SaaS category, serves coaches worldwide, and is expanding toward direct-to-consumer offerings. Its team spans San Francisco and Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Da Nang and Ha Noi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Not stated; requires 5+ years of relevant experience
- **Work model:** At office

## Responsibilities

You will train and adapt models using Everfit's product data and feedback, then take them into production. You will own the technical work from problem definition and data preparation through training, evaluation, release, and monitoring.

Some problems call for a small classifier or ranking model. Others may benefit from adapting a pretrained language or vision model. You will assess where training can improve quality, personalization, speed, or cost, recommend an approach, and test it against the current product.

You will work with Applied AI Engineers, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, and product partners. Your focus will be training data, learned representations, model adaptation, evaluation, and the model lifecycle. Applied AI colleagues contribute the surrounding context, tools, and application workflows. Together, you will make sure model improvements reach users and solve the intended problem.

### Choose the problem and approach

- Work with product and domain partners to define the user problem, the decision a model should support, and how to measure a better result.
- Investigate whether errors come from the model, labels, missing context, reference data, or product integration.
- Compare the current workflow with simple baselines, existing models, and training-based approaches. Recommend the approach the evidence supports.

### Build data that supports learning

- Work with data engineers and domain experts to prepare training and evaluation datasets. Define labels, review disagreements, and check for missing records, duplicates, and uneven coverage.
- Turn product feedback into useful training examples. Check that a coach edit, click, purchase, or correction means what the training objective assumes.
- Keep training and evaluation separate. Use time, user, coach, or workspace boundaries where needed, and prevent future information from entering earlier examples.
- Test unfamiliar users and items, sparse histories, and important failure cases. Distinguish missing activity records from inactivity when working with engagement data.

### Train, adapt, and evaluate models

- Build task-specific models and adapt pretrained models where appropriate. Methods may include supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including low-rank adaptation (LoRA).
- Choose metrics that match the task. Examine ranking quality, per-category classification errors, language quality, or recognition and portion errors as appropriate.
- Check uncertainty and define when a model should abstain, request more information, or use a fallback. Review the consequences of different mistakes with product partners.
- Version datasets, labels, transformations, model artifacts, and evaluation settings so another engineer can reproduce the result.

### Deliver and improve the product

- Work with backend, data, and DevOps colleagues to deploy and serve models in batch or online services. Keep training and serving transformations consistent, and test the full path to the result users receive.
- Compare model quality with response time, memory use, and operating cost. Diagnose failures and make improvements without hiding regressions in an average score.
- Run controlled product experiments with the team. Measure useful outcomes alongside offline scores, and document what the evidence supports.
- Monitor model and data performance after release. Validate updates before deployment, maintain a rollback path, and turn confirmed failures into regression tests.
- Protect coach and client data in datasets, inference, and logs. Follow workspace access boundaries and approved retention and deletion rules.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Skills and experience**

- Good English communication, with clear explanations of technical choices and limitations.
- 5+ years of relevant experience in Machine Learning,

This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team's positioning from "a team that delivers what it is asked to build" to "a technical partner that other studios actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game's success." That requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems across mobile, PC, and console, and drive focused R&D, including applied AI in game development, while ensuring flawless delivery across multiple live and co-development projects.

The challenge is dual: you will build toward the future while keeping current production healthy. You will need to anticipate what partner studios will need before they ask, identify and close skill gaps across a team of around 35 to 40 programmers, and establish technical standards that make the studio a reference point across the organization, not just a capable executor.

**Day-to-day responsibilities:**

- Monitor the technical health of multiple concurrent projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track.
- Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams.
- Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines.
- Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to programmers, conduct periodic competency assessments, and build clear development paths.
- Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality.
- Plan strategic resources and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director.

**Success in your first year:** You will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in line with the studio's long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone.

**Reporting and collaboration:** You will report to the Studio Technical Director and work across a programming department of around 35 to 40 people at multiple seniority levels, supporting live service and co-development projects on mobile, PC, and console. You will work closely with department heads and team leads from Game Design, Art, and Production, as well as Studio Directors and the Studio Manager. You will also work directly with Technical Managers and Technical Directors from co-development partner studios.

**Career outlook:** If the opportunity arises and the qualifications are in place, this position is a direct pathway to the Studio Technical Director role. This outcome is not guaranteed, but it is a realistic progression for the right person.

No deep coding is required. Your job is to investigate issues by checking data, logs, and basic settings, resolve what you can, and bring in the right team when needed. You will be trained on our products before handling cases on your own.

- Fixing or changing source code.

### System Architecture & Design

- Define and maintain system architecture for complex embedded systems and system-of-systems.
- Analyze functional, logical, and technical interactions between software, hardware, communication networks, cloud services, mobile applications, and vehicle systems.
- Identify, specify, and maintain system interfaces and interaction models.

- Ensure architectural consistency across all engineering disciplines.

- Develop mobile agent applications on Android and/or iOS for managed devices.

- Contribute to device security flows, including enrollment, attestation, key provisioning, and certificate lifecycle, under Tech Lead guidance.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure code coverage meets requirements.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural and procedural improvements.
- Fix bugs, optimize performance, and resolve technical debt.
- Stay updated with Android Enterprise, the Apple MDM protocol, and SCEP/DEP.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education**
- Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Security, or an equivalent field.

**Experience**
- 3–5 years of experience in software development.
- Experience in mobile development or device security products is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

*Software Development*
- **Backend:** Golang, Java, Node.js, or Python; RESTful APIs; SQL/NoSQL databases.
- **Frontend:** React.js or Vue.js, TypeScript, responsive design.
- **Mobile:** Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift); React Native is a plus.
- **Cloud:** Basic AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda); Firebase Cloud Messaging.
- **Tools:** Git, Docker, CI/CD, Agile/Scrum.

*Hardware Security and Trusted Execution*

Working knowledge of on-device security chips and environments, and how to use them in real-world applications. Deep expertise on all platforms is not required.
- Basic understanding of SEP, key generation and storage via Secure Enclave-backed keys, biometric-bound keys, and Keychain access control.
- Use of Android Keystore with StrongBox; understanding of software, TEE-backed, and StrongBox-backed keys; familiarity with Key Attestation.
- Familiarity with PCRs, sealed storage, remote attestation, and EK/AIK. Ability to learn on the job for desktop agent work.
- Familiarity with HSM and cloud KMS concepts. Integration experience with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, or PKCS#11 is a plus.
- Understanding of Root of Trust, Secure Boot, Verified Boot, and attestation concepts.

*Cryptography and Applied Cryptography*

Understanding and correct use of common cryptographic algorithms for each problem. Designing cryptographic protocols from scratch is not required.
- AES-128/256 with GCM, CBC, and CTR modes; avoidance of nonce reuse and padding oracles; familiarity with ChaCha20-Poly1305.
- RSA (PKCS#1 v1.5, OAEP, PSS) with keys of at least 2048 bits; understanding of why RSA-PSS is preferred for signatures.
- ECDSA, EdDSA (Ed25519), and ECDH/X25519 over NIST and Curve25519; understanding of why ECC is preferred on mobile.
- SHA-2, SHA-3, HMAC; KDFs such as HKD

title: Software Engineer (Fullstack, AI-Native)

description:
## Company

SkyLab, based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The posting does not describe the company's industry or products.

## Details

- **Reports to:** VP of Engineering
- **Work model:** On-site
- **Salary:** Not stated in the posting (compensation includes a competitive base salary, performance bonus, and equity participation)

## Responsibilities

You will work across the company's new and existing products and projects. You own the features you work on from technical design to production. You receive the product requirements, write the technical specification, plan the build, estimate and commit to your own dates, build the feature, and stay with it until it works in production. Nobody writes the design for you, and nobody breaks the work into tickets for you.

The engineering team uses AI coding tools every day, and this is expected. The role requires judgement around those tools: deciding what to build and how before generating any code, breaking down the work, recognising when the output is wrong, and being accountable for everything that ships under your name, regardless of who or what wrote it. Candidates who pass requirements to an AI tool and pass the result to review are not a fit. The team wants engineers who think the problem through, plan the work, deliver it, and use AI to do so faster.

### Design and plan

- Turn product requirements into a technical specification covering functional requirements, acceptance criteria, data model, service boundaries, state changes, and failure cases.
- Raise time, feasibility, and scope problems while the requirements are still being written, not after the build starts.
- Present your design at architecture review, defend the decisions, and change the design where the review finds real gaps.
- Break the build into tasks with hour estimates and due dates, and commit to them.

### Build and deliver

- Build the feature end to end, using AI tools where they help and your own judgement throughout.
- Keep the specification current as the design changes during the build, so QA and other engineers always work from the real design.
- Write tests that would fail if the behaviour were wrong. Passing tests and coverage numbers are the minimum, not proof that the code works.
- Review your own work before asking anyone else to, and attach evidence when you merge: the tests, the results, and what you checked.
- Report progress daily and raise a schedule slip on the day you identify it, stating what it affects and what you propose.
- Deploy, verify that the feature works in production, and fix what breaks. Work is considered done when it is verified working in production, not when it is merged.

### Work with the team

- Work with the product manager and QA engineer on your feature from requirements through release.
- Review other engineers' code, including AI-generated code, with the same care as your own.
- Document how the systems you build work so the next engineer can pick them up.

## Requirements / Qualifications

### Mindset and working style (in priority order)

1. **Thinks and plans before building.** Given an unclear request, asks the right questions, identifies what is missing, and produces a plan covering the data, edge cases, failure modes, and how to verify it works, before opening an AI tool. Able to show specifications or designs you have written.
2. **Works independently.** Takes a problem from requirements to production without someone directing each step. When stuck, comes with options and a recommendation rather than a question alone. Delivers on committed dates and says so early when unable to.
3. **Uses AI as a tool, not a substitute for understanding.** Uses Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar daily and knows where they fail, such as invented APIs and fields, wrong assumptions about data, race conditions, missing tenant or permission checks, and tests that pass without checking anything. Can explain every line shipped and show how AI tools have sped up real work and how you caught them being wrong.
4. **Has shipped and run real systems.** Has built software running in production and been responsible for it, including debugging live problems, reading log

The role builds backend services that convert e-commerce transaction and settlement data into accurate billing records, including financial calculations, reconciliation checks, batch processing, and ERP integrations, in collaboration with product, finance, and other engineers.

**What you will build:**

- **Settlement ingestion:** Import normalized order, refund, payout, wallet movement, and fee records from files, APIs, or object storage. Validate required fields, handle duplicates, and support corrected or reissued data.
- **Billing calculation engine:** Calculate per-order-item service fees, marketplace fee allocation, rebates, cost and margin adjustments, and bundle splits. Apply effective-dated contract terms and preserve the rate used for each calculation.

- Implement background jobs with safe retry behavior, idempotency keys, backfills, and structured logs.
- Write unit, integration, and data-quality tests using synthetic financial examples and edge cases such as partial refunds, missing fees, late settlements, and restatements.

- Comfort working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to confirm requirements and investigate data issues.

**Nice to have:**

- Curiosity about AI/LLM security concepts is a plus. Prior experience is not required.

**Team & Collaboration**

## Company

SkyLab is a Singapore-headquartered AI infrastructure company operating across Southeast and North Asia. It designs, builds, and operates GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) environments on NVIDIA platforms for AI model developers and enterprises whose training and inference workloads depend on healthy nodes and links around the clock.

## Details

- **Level:** Mid / Senior (Mid: 3+ years of experience; Senior: 5+ years of experience)
- **Type:** Full-time

## Responsibilities

The DevOps team builds and runs the platform that keeps SkyLab's GPU infrastructure healthy. The monitoring and automation stack watches hundreds of GPU servers across every site, covering hardware health, network fabric, and alerting that gets the right people involved quickly. As new sites come online across the region, each one joins this platform from day one.

You will join the team that owns this platform end to end. Everything is infrastructure-as-code, reviewed through merge requests, and runs on-premises rather than on public cloud. You will work closely with the Data Center Operations team and with engineers overseas, so clear written English is an important part of the job.

- **Observability:** Operate and improve a multi-site monitoring platform, where each site keeps working on its own and a central NOC gives fleet-wide visibility.
- **Hardware and network health:** Use out-of-band server data and network telemetry to spot issues with GPUs, nodes, and links early.
- **Automation:** Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment as code, and keep the CMDB accurate so it drives discovery and alerting.
- **AI-augmented operations:** Apply AI tools and agents to reduce manual work, such as alert triage, incident summaries, and runbook automation, and use AI assistants to write and review code faster.
- **Alerting:** Tune alerts to be clear and actionable, and keep the runbooks behind them up to date.
- **Troubleshooting:** Investigate issues across hardware, network, OS, and application layers, find the root cause, and share what was learned.
- **Reliability and security:** Help maintain highly available services, backup and recovery plans, secrets, and regular patching.
- **CI/CD and tooling:** Improve pipelines and build internal tools that make changes easier and safer for other teams.
- **Collaboration:** Document your work and partner with Data Center Operations and overseas engineers on design and problem-solving.
- **Toolset:** Prometheus/Grafana stack, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes (k3s), Proxmox, GitLab CI, NetBox (CMDB), Jira, and PagerDuty.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must-have**

- **Experience:** Mid: 3+ years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure roles. Senior: 5+ years, including running production systems.
- Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
- Hands-on experience with Ansible and Terraform.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production.
- Experience with Prometheus-based monitoring (PromQL, alert rules, exporters) and Grafana.
- Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, VLANs, and basic routing.
- Scripting in Python and Bash.
- Virtualization experience, ideally Proxmox or another KVM-based hypervisor.
- Git-based workflow with code review and CI/CD, ideally GitLab CI.
- Comfortable communicating in English, both written and spoken.

**Nice to have**

- Server hardware and BMC management (Redfish, IPMI, iDRAC), ideally with GPU/HPC servers.
- Datacenter networking, especially Juniper.
- Thanos, Loki, or Grafana at multi-site scale.
- NetBox or another CMDB.
- PostgreSQL high availability (Patroni, etcd) or object storage (MinIO, S3).
- Incident tooling (PagerDuty, Jira Service Management) and on-call experience.
- Secrets management (SOPS, Vault) and CVE remediation.
- Experience building or using AI agents and LLM-based tools in operations (AIOps).
- Public cloud (AWS or Azure), Go, or certifications such as CKA/CKAD.

## Company

M_Service (MoMo) operates the MoMo super app, a mobile platform in Vietnam that offers payment and financial services. The Data Engineering team is moving the platform from one built primarily on BigQuery to a hybrid lakehouse across cloud and on-premise infrastructure. - **Data governance:** Access control, PII separation, data contracts, and tools that keep the platform compliant.

- Help separate PII and PII-free workloads with appropriate access controls.
- Build tools and frameworks that other engineers and teams use to ship data faster.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or a related backend or infrastructure role, with production systems you built or ran.
- Strong SQL and hands-on experience with at least one of Python, Java, or Scala.

This role is a key part of the QA organization and serves as the source of truth for what is tested, how it is described, and how a release is proven ready to ship.

The role focuses on test design leadership and documentation ownership. It works as a peer to the Test Automation Lead, who owns frameworks and CI infrastructure, and ensures test coverage scales rigorously as the product grows.

### Test Case Design Ownership

- Own the end-to-end test case design strategy across mobile apps, web portals, APIs, and IoT devices.
- Define and enforce standards for how test cases are written: structure, granularity, preconditions, expected results, and traceability to requirements.
- Review and approve test cases authored by QA engineers, and coach the team on test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transition, risk-based testing, and exploratory charters).
- Maintain a master test case library that is organized, deduplicated, version-controlled, and tagged for reuse across releases and product lines.
- Drive coverage analysis by mapping test cases to requirements, user stories, and risk areas; identify gaps and prioritize remediation.
- Define and maintain reusable test data sets, environments, and fixtures that test cases depend on.
- Establish enterprise-wide quality standards, testing methodologies, and governance across all Safetrust engineering teams.
- Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Security, and Customer Success to incorporate quality objectives throughout the software development lifecycle.
- Define release quality gates, risk acceptance criteria, and go/no-go recommendations for production deployments.
- Develop and maintain quality dashboards measuring defect trends, release readiness, customer-reported issues, automation coverage, and engineering quality metrics.
- Lead root cause analysis for significant production incidents and establish preventative quality improvements.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality engineering maturity, process optimization, and organizational scalability.
- Develop onboarding programs, mentoring frameworks, and technical training for Quality Engineers across all disciplines.
- Collaborate with the QA Automation Lead to define enterprise automation priorities and maximize automation return on investment.

### Test Documentation Ownership

- Own the structure and quality of all test documentation, including test plans, test strategies, test reports, release sign-off documents, RCA reports, and regression suites.
- Establish templates, naming conventions, and lifecycle rules for every test artefact across the QA team.
- Maintain the test management system (Zephyr or equivalent) as the single source of truth, keeping it clean, current, and queryable.
- Produce clear, actionable release-readiness reports for engineering and product leadership covering what was tested, what was skipped, known issues, and residual risk.
- Maintain audit-ready documentation for security, compliance, and customer reviews (SOC 2, ISO 27001 evidence, customer test reports).
- Document and continuously improve QA processes, runbooks, and onboarding material so the team scales without losing rigor.

### Team Leadership

- Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers spanning manual, mobile, device, and automation testing.
- Set quality KPIs (coverage, defect leakage, escape rate, test cycle time) and report them to engineering leadership.
- Plan QA capacity per release, balancing manual, exploratory

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
## Company

Dedale is a provider of strategic intelligence for the technology sector. It employs over 100 full-time research analysts and planners and draws on a network of more than 10,000 market professionals to deliver on-the-ground intelligence to investors and corporates, with a core focus on North America and Europe. Dedale is expanding its engineering capabilities in Vietnam, where it already has a team of 16.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Founding Software Engineer

## Responsibilities

You will be a core contributor on a growing, high-ownership engineering team. This means working across the full stack, taking features from design to production, and being someone the team genuinely relies on, technically and otherwise.

Day to day, this includes:

- Building new features on both the customer-facing platform and the internal tools our analysts use to produce intelligence.
- Designing and maintaining the APIs that power our product.
- Contributing to our AI initiatives, not just integrating models, but thinking carefully about where AI genuinely adds value in our product.
- Participating in architecture decisions and technical discussions, not just executing them.
- Reviewing code with the goal of making the whole team better, not just catching bugs.
- Staying curious about new tools and approaches, and bringing that curiosity to the team.

**Your first 90 days:**

- **Week 1:** Get up to speed through onboarding sessions on the business, the clients, and what we are building, while setting up your environment and getting familiar with the codebase. You will likely ship something small by the end of the week, with the goal of building a solid foundation rather than proving anything yet.
- **Weeks 2 to 4:** Contribute independently by picking up bugs and small improvements that let you navigate the codebase with growing confidence. By the end of the month, you are working on your first real customer-facing feature, with enough scope to be meaningful.
- **Days 30 to 90:** Become a full contributor. Take ownership of features and deliver them without needing hand-holding, and make your code reviews genuinely useful to the team. Reinforce our standards rather than learning them, and be autonomous on most technical topics, even where some parts of the codebase are still new to you.

By day 90, we should be able to give you something and trust that it will get done well.

## Requirements / Qualifications

You have solid experience building production-grade applications, enough to know what good looks like and why it matters. You are comfortable with ambiguity, can navigate a codebase that is still evolving, and take ownership without needing to be managed.

Specifically:

- Strong command of TypeScript, React, NestJS and GraphQL, well enough to have opinions about them.
- Experience with relational databases and data modeling (we use PostgreSQL via Prisma).
- Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, and automated testing as a normal part of your workflow, not an afterthought.
- You write code for the next person who will read it, not just for today's deadline.
- Fluent in English, written and spoken. Our team and documentation are in English.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience with workflow automation tools (we use n8n extensively).
- Familiarity with LLM tooling or AI integration in production contexts.
- Experience in a startup or small team environment where you wore multiple hats.

description:
## Company

VinSmart Future (VSF) is the technology company of Vingroup. It was formed by merging the group's technology units, including VinApp, VinIT, and VinBigdata. The company builds AI and large-scale technology systems, including data, models, and infrastructure.

## Details

- **Level:** AI Researcher (research position)

## Responsibilities

VSF is hiring AI Researchers to build large language models that can compete with the best in the world. Vietnamese is the starting point and a market where VSF intends to be uncontested, but the benchmark is global. This is a research role. You will own open problems, run the experiments that resolve them, publish the results, and work with engineers to incorporate what works into the model. Research depth is the primary criterion. Engineering ability is a baseline requirement, not the main differentiator.

**1. Own a research agenda (primary)**

- Identify and address open problems in LLMs, reasoning from first principles rather than from the most recent paper.
- Design and run rigorous experiments with clear hypotheses, controlled ablations, honest baselines, and error bars. Use scaling-law-informed small-scale studies before committing to a large training run.
- Publish at top venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, AAAI, CVPR, and ECCV/ICCV.
- Release models, code, and benchmarks where appropriate, with the goal that VSF's work is reproducible and widely used.

**2. Research areas**

- **Post-training and alignment:** SFT, instruction tuning, RLHF, DPO, GRPO and successors, reward modeling, and preference data design. Investigate failure modes such as alignment tax, cross-task see-saw effects, reward hacking, and mode collapse.
- **Reasoning and agents:** RL from verifiable rewards, long chain-of-thought and test-time compute, self-verification and process supervision, tool use, multi-step planning, and long-horizon agentic behavior.
- **Long context, memory, and retrieval:** Context extension and its failure curve, efficient attention, retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented architectures, and deciding what a model should store in its weights versus retrieve.
- **Efficiency and inference:** Distillation, quantization, sparsity, speculative decoding, and KV-cache design, treated as research problems in the accuracy, latency, and cost trade-off.
- **Multilingual and Vietnamese:** Cross-lingual transfer, low-resource adaptation, and the ways English-first design choices (tokenization, diacritics, compounding) fail on Vietnamese. Understanding why these failures occur is part of the job.

**3. Evaluation as research**

- Build evaluation suites the field lacks, especially for Vietnamese and multilingual generation, reasoning, and long-context behavior.
- Design automated evaluations that detect regressions and cross-task interference early in training.
- Be skeptical of your own results. Check for contamination, leakage, and benchmark overfitting before reviewers or users do.

**4. Transfer to product**

- Work with research engineers to move validated methods into the production model and serving stack (vLLM, TGI, Triton).
- You are not expected to own the serving stack or an on-call rotation, but you should understand latency, throughput, and cost well enough that your methods hold up in production.
- Mentor junior researchers and interns.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Research (primary)**

- PhD in Computer Science, AI, or ML, or a Master's degree with an equivalent research record.
- First-author publications at A*-ranked venues.
- Demonstrated ability to take a problem independently from question to result to published paper.
- Real depth in at least one of the research areas above. Breadth across several is a plus, but genuine depth in one area is preferred.

title: NVH CAE Engineer
description:
## Company

VinFast is an electric vehicle (EV) manufacturer that designs and produces electric cars and other sustainable mobility solutions.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi, Vietnam

## Responsibilities

The NVH CAE Engineer specializes in full vehicle NVH development. The role conducts structural dynamics and vibro-acoustic simulations to analyze and optimize full vehicle and trimmed body systems (BIW, interior trims, and acoustic packages) so they meet NVH performance targets across the frequency spectrum. The engineer works closely with design, test, and system engineering teams to deliver robust, simulation-driven NVH solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop NVH CAE models at full vehicle, trimmed body, and subsystem levels.
- Execute a range of NVH simulations, including modal analysis, dynamic stiffness, Noise Transfer Function (NTF), and Vibration Transfer Function (VTF).
- Evaluate simulation results against defined targets and report NVH performance status.
- Conduct root cause analysis and propose countermeasures for performance gaps.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement design improvements for NVH optimization.
- Correlate and validate CAE models using test data to ensure simulation accuracy and reliability.
- Support alignment with VTS targets and validation planning.
- Contribute to the enhancement of CAE methodologies, tools, and processes to improve trimmed body NVH simulation accuracy.

**Key Deliverables**

- Provide comprehensive simulation results and reports covering modal, dynamic stiffness, NTF, and VTF analyses, with clear comparison against targets.
- Generate regular NVH performance status reports highlighting alignment with targets, gaps, and associated risks.
- Produce detailed root cause analyses and propose effective, quantified countermeasures for NVH issues.
- Deliver correlated and validated CAE models with documented accuracy against test data (modal, FRF, acoustic response).
- Support implementation of NVH design improvements by providing technically justified recommendations to cross-functional teams.
- Ensure alignment with VTS targets and contribute to validation planning through simulation insights.
- Enhance CAE processes by delivering improved methodologies, tools, and automation solutions for trimmed body NVH simulations.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field, with specialization in acoustics or vibrations.
- 8+ years of experience in NVH CAE, with hands-on exposure to trimmed body or full vehicle NVH simulations.
- Strong knowledge of structural dynamics, vibro-acoustics, and noise transfer mechanisms across frequency ranges.
- Proficiency in CAE tools such as Nastran, OptiStruct, Abaqus, or Ansys, and Simcenter, Actran, or Virtual.Lab, along with pre/post-processing tools such as HyperMesh or ANSA.
- Experience in model correlation with test data and the ability to interpret results to drive design improvements.

## Responsibilities

**Choose the problem and approach**

- Work with product and domain partners to define the user problem, the decision a model should support, and how to measure a better result.
- Investigate whether errors come from the model, labels, missing context, reference data, or product integration.
- Compare the current workflow with simple baselines, existing models, and training-based approaches. Recommend the approach the evidence supports.

**Build data that supports learning**

- Work with data engineers and domain experts to prepare training and evaluation datasets. Define labels, review disagreements, and check for missing records, duplicates, and uneven coverage.
- Turn product feedback into useful training examples. Check that a coach edit, click, purchase, or correction means what the training objective assumes.
- Keep training and evaluation separate. Use time, user, coach, or workspace boundaries where needed, and prevent future information from entering earlier examples.
- Test unfamiliar users and items, sparse histories, and important failure cases. Distinguish missing activity records from inactivity when working with engagement data.

**Train, adapt, and evaluate models**

- Build task-specific models and adapt pretrained models where appropriate. Methods may include supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), distillation, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), including low-rank adaptation (LoRA).
- Choose metrics that match the task. Examine ranking quality, per-category classification errors, language quality, or recognition and portion errors as appropriate.
- Check uncertainty and define when a model should abstain, request more information, or use a fallback. Review the consequences of different mistakes with product partners.
- Version datasets, labels, transformations, model artifacts, and evaluation settings so that another engineer can reproduce the result.

**Deliver and improve the product**

- Work with backend, data, and DevOps colleagues to deploy and serve models in batch or online services. Keep training and serving transformations consistent, and test the full path to the result users receive.
- Compare model quality with response time, memory use, and operating cost. Diagnose failures and make improvements without hiding regressions in an average score.
- Run controlled product experiments with the team. Measure useful outcomes alongside offline scores, and document what the evidence supports.
- Monitor model and data performance after release. Validate updates before deployment, maintain a rollback path, and turn confirmed failures into regression tests.

- Experience preparing training data and developing features or embeddings, including work with missing values, imbalanced labels, noisy feedback, and limited examples.
- Experience fine-tuning Transformer models (e.g., via Hugging Face) for downstream tasks and domain-specific datasets.
- Experience choosing baselines, validation splits, and task-appropriate metrics; preventing data leakage; and analyzing errors across important user groups and cases. You can assess whether an improvement is meaningful for the product.
- Experience training or adapting models with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn, taking them into production, and measuring their performance after release. You can explain the decisions you owned, the failures you investigated, and the results.
- Strong practical depth in at least one relevant area: recommendation and ranking, classification, natural language processing and language model adaptation, or computer vision and multimodal learning.
- Experience with reproducible training pipelines, experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, and containerized deployment using Docker or equivalent tools. You can work with automated testing and release workflows.
- Good software engineering habits, including version control, readable code, tests, and documentation.
- Ability to turn ambiguous product problems into practical experiments, define data and evaluation requirements, and make evidence-based decis

- Experience with industry-standard simulators such as VCS, Xcelium, or Questa, and with version control systems.
- Solid scripting skills in Python, Perl, or Tcl for automation and regression management.
