title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Platform)
description:
## Company

The company is not named in the posting. It is building an Agentic Platform that helps customers deploy and operate AI agents at production scale. The platform provides ready-to-use services and components that agent developers can integrate instead of building from scratch, and it follows open protocols to connect with tools, data sources, and other agents.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior

## Responsibilities

This role is split roughly 70% platform and backend engineering and 30% AI, AI agents, and related protocols. You will work directly with the engineering team to take platform services from architecture and implementation through to operation, ensuring high availability, low latency, security, and scalability.

### Platform & Backend Engineering (~70%)

- Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs that meet high standards for availability, latency, and security.
- Build platform infrastructure components that support the agent lifecycle, including where agents run, communication between agents, tools, and services, state management, and security and authorization.
- Build a secure sandbox runtime where AI agents can execute generated code and tools in isolated environments. This includes containerization or microVMs (Docker, gVisor, Firecracker), isolation through namespaces and seccomp, resource limits (CPU, memory, network), and strict egress controls so that untrusted agent actions never leak to the host or to other tenants.
- Design data models and data flows across SQL (MySQL), NoSQL (MongoDB), and vector databases, ensuring consistency, throughput, and resilience.
- Integrate message brokers and event-driven backbones (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS) for asynchronous communication between internal platform services.
- Identify and resolve system issues, including performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, race conditions, security vulnerabilities, and resource leaks.
- Design and implement observability systems (metrics, logs, distributed tracing) to monitor and debug the platform in production.
- Research, experiment with, and evaluate new technology solutions to address technical system challenges.

### AI & Agentic Capabilities (~30%)

- Design platform services for AI agents, and proactively monitor trending agent capabilities in the market so customers always have access to the latest features.
- Build and integrate MCP servers and adapters for the A2A protocol to connect agents with tools, data sources, and other agents.
- Integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, and others) into the platform in a framework-agnostic way. Design abstractions so the platform does not depend on any specific model or framework.
- Design and build agent sandbox capabilities, including code and tool execution environments (code interpreter, REPL, tool-call runtime) that let AI agents run code, evaluate output, and iterate safely. Support multi-language execution, persistent session state, file I/O, and deterministic reproducibility so agents can reliably think, execute, observe, and refine.
- Define and enforce sandbox security boundaries, including permissions per agent and per task (read-only filesystem, network allow-lists, approval gates for sensitive actions). Deeply integrate with the platform's authorization layer so that sandbox actions can be audited, traced, and revoked.
- Write clients (SDK, CLI, AI agent skills) that help customers integrate with and use the platform.
- Apply AI tools (coding assistants, AI code review, AI-assisted testing and debugging) to daily development and operations workflows to improve team productivity.

### Engineering Practices & Ownership (both areas)

- Write clean code with unit and integration tests, and maintain quality through code reviews.
- Own features and services from design to production, and proactively propose architectural improvements.
- Guide and review junior and mid-level engineers, and contribute to the engineering culture.
- Work closely with product, infrastructure, and stakeholders to translate requirements into clear technical solutions.

## Requirements / Qualifications

### Must Have

**Background and Experience**

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience building backend services and distributed systems running in production. Years of experience are a reference only; demonstrated capability is the deciding factor.
- Strong foundation in software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and best practices

The engineer collaborates with IT, engineering, and other security teams based in Indonesia and India to build, monitor, and evolve security defenses, and stays ahead of adversaries through threat intelligence and detection engineering.

**DFIR (Digital Forensics and Incident Response): Windows, macOS, Linux & Cloud**

- Lead DFIR investigations across Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints and servers, identifying attack vectors, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement, and root cause.
- Perform disk, memory, file-system, registry, and artifact analysis to reconstruct attacker activity and establish timelines.
- Analyze Windows artifacts, including Event Logs, Registry, Prefetch, Amcache, Shimcache, SRUM, PowerShell, scheduled tasks, and browser artifacts.
- Investigate macOS artifacts, including Unified Logs, LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons, persistence mechanisms, shell history, browser data, and file-system activity.
- Perform timeline analysis and artifact correlation to reconstruct attacker behavior and determine the scope and impact of incidents.

**Threat Hunting & Detections**

- Continuously monitor internal and external systems to detect threats, uncover vulnerabilities, and ensure policy compliance.
- Correlate indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) with internal activity using SIEM, EDR, and custom automation.
- Deploy, configure, and monitor security tools, including EDR, DLP, and VMDR.
- Analyze dark web activity, OSINT sources, and intelligence platforms to identify emerging threats.
- Produce weekly and monthly hunting and intelligence reports with actionable recommendations.

**Incident Response**

- Lead incident response, perform forensics, and conduct log analysis to identify root causes.
- Support containment, eradication, and remediation efforts with cross-functional teams.
- Develop security automations and workflows using Python or Bash.
- Collaborate with the Threat Detection team to fine-tune alerts and improve detection coverage.
- Contribute to IR playbooks, runbooks, and post-incident reviews.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Qualifications**

- 4 to 7 years of experience in cybersecurity, with exposure to enterprise security, threat hunting, and incident response.

Gradion is an engineering services company with 23+ years of experience, 300+ specialists across 7 countries, and more than 100 enterprise clients. It works across AI, data, cybersecurity, robotics, and enterprise platforms.

## Details

- **Location:** Da Nang, Vietnam (the company also hires in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and Bangkok)
- **Seniority/Level:** Staff Software Engineer (AI-Native)
- **Work model:** Hybrid; Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00

## Responsibilities

- Set technical direction across systems and teams. Turn ambiguous problems into architecture, constraints, and an approach that engineers can execute against.
- Own architecture and delivery for complex systems spanning web, desktop, and mobile front ends; back-end services and APIs; data pipelines; infrastructure; testing; security; and operations.
- Stay involved from specification and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.
- Work through AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, and their successors) under a zero hand-written production code rule. Own every line that ships, even though you do not type it.
- Turn outcomes into specifications, give agents the context and constraints they need, direct implementation, and prove results before anything ships.
- Design how engineers work with AI agents: establish conventions, repository context, tooling, evaluation methods, and quality gates that make agents reliable on real production work.
- Make the decisions AI will not make for you, including boundaries, data models, failure behaviour, scalability, security controls, migration paths, and expensive-to-reverse trade-offs.
- Decide when to build, when not to build, when to pay down technical debt, and when an agent's plausible answer is wrong.
- Raise the quality of engineering output. Review the implementations carrying the most risk, set standards others can review against, and build mechanisms that catch bad output before production.
- Move across application architecture, APIs, front ends, infrastructure, CI/CD, testing, and production issues when the problem demands it.
- Remove recurring problems at the source. When several teams hit the same issue, change the architecture, platform, tooling, or engineering practice behind it rather than applying only the immediate fix.
- Lead technical conversations with clients and stakeholders. Challenge assumptions, identify key constraints, and turn unclear business problems into technical direction that people can act on.
- Multiply other engineers through reviews, architecture discussions, written guidance, pairing, and better engineering practices, without relying on formal authority.
- Create reusable leverage by turning successful solutions into patterns, tooling, documentation, or practices that other teams can adopt.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Around nine years or more of building and running production software, including systems you have supported well beyond their initial release.
- Strong software engineering fund

title: Senior/ Staff Offensive Security Engineer
description:
## Company

BE Corp operates the Be application, which offers transportation, food, and passenger car booking services.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior / Staff

## Responsibilities

- Plan and perform penetration tests on web applications, mobile applications (iOS/Android), APIs, and internal/external networks.
- Assess the security of cloud environments (primarily GCP), Kubernetes workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and identity systems such as Azure AD / Entra ID.
- Plan and run red team and adversary emulation exercises based on realistic threat scenarios and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, within agreed rules of engagement.
- Work with the security operations team in purple team exercises to validate and improve detection coverage, alert quality, and incident response readiness.
- Review the security of new features, system designs, and third-party integrations, and perform threat modeling with engineering teams.
- Run the vulnerability management process for offensive findings: triage, risk rating, remediation guidance, and verification of fixes.
- Coordinate and support external penetration tests and the bug bounty program, including scoping, triage, and validating reported issues.
- Write scripts and internal tools to automate reconnaissance, attack surface monitoring, and repetitive testing tasks.
- Write clear reports with risk ratings, proof-of-concept, and actionable remediation steps for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in penetration testing, red teaming, application security, or a related offensive security role.
- Hands-on experience testing web applications, APIs, and mobile applications, with a strong understanding of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP MASVS.
- Experience with offensive tooling such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Frida, or C2 frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic).
- Familiarity with GCP (must-have requirement). Experience attacking cloud environments, Kubernetes, and identity platforms is a strong plus.
- Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell) for exploit development, automation, and tool development.
- Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Linux/Windows), Active Directory, and common attack techniques.
- Ability to read and review source code (e.g., Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin, Swift) to find security vulnerabilities.
- Experience in the banking, fintech, or financial services industry is a plus.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience working within a collaborative team environment, with a strong sense of ethics and responsible disclosure.
- Preferred certifications: OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, GPEN, GXPN, or equivalent. CVEs, bug bounty records, or CTF achievements are a plus.

## Benefits

- Competitive compensation, including a 13th-month wage and up to 3 months of performance-based bonus.
- MacBook and essential equipment provided.
- BE Corp budget, which varies by level, for services such as transportation, food, and passenger car bookings in the Be application.
- Social insurance contributions that vary based on the individual's level.
- Annual health checks and premium medical healthcare (PTI) after probation.
- 15 days of annual leave for all staff.
- Company trips, team-building activities, and happy hour events organized quarterly or annually.

- **On-device Validation & Benchmarking:** Execute on-device validation, downstream benchmarking, and performance analysis to provide early feasibility insights and readiness signals.
- **Cross-stack Debugging:** Identify issues early across model, quantization, runtime, backend, and system layers, and drive resolution with system, compiler, runtime, and platform engineering teams.
- **Rapid Prototype Enablement:** Provide early inference support and prototype enablement for new model architectures before the broader ecosystem is fully mature.
- **Production-readiness Delivery:** Translate research models and early technology IP into robust on-device AI experiences suitable for productization, demos, customer evaluation, and business decision-making.
- **Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:** Maintain clear technical documentation, benchmark reports, debugging notes, and onboarding guides to improve team execution and cross-team collaboration.

### Education & Background

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML model deployment, optimization, benchmarking, or software development for edge, mobile, compute, or embedded platforms.

### Technical & Domain Knowledge

- Strong understanding of GenAI model architectures such as LLMs, vision-language models, diffusion models, or multimodal models.
- Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, graph conversion, profiling, memory analysis, and runtime performance tuning.
- Familiarity with AI software stacks, inference runtimes, hardware accelerators, and debugging workflows across model, runtime, backend, and system layers.
- Ability to analyze benchmark results, identify bottlenecks, and communicate deployment feasibility and performance trade-offs clearly.

### Soft Skills

- Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive technical execution across ambiguous and fast-moving projects.
- Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to break down complex cross-stack issues and coordinate resolution with partner teams.
- Clear communication skills to present technical findings, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.

### Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Qualcomm AI software stacks, QNN, NPU acceleration, or similar edge AI deployment toolchains.
- Experience onboarding or benchmarking LLMs, VLMs, multimodal models, diffusion models, or other modern GenAI architectures.
- Experience collaborating with research, quantization, backend, runtime, system, and product teams to deliver production-ready AI features.

### Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
- **OR** Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
- **OR** PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engine

title: Agentic Backend Engineer [Vietnam]
description:
## Company

TaloTrace is an AI-powered QA platform that autonomously tests web and mobile applications. It discovers issues and provides evidence for each finding, including recorded video, logs, reproduction steps, and severity, so engineering teams can act on results directly. Unlike traditional automation tools that report only pass or fail, it produces a complete trace for every issue.

## Details

- **Location:** Vietnam
- **Level:** Open to candidates with 2+ years of experience building backend systems, agentic systems, or end-to-end products. The team includes engineers at different experience levels.
- **Salary:** Not stated
- **Work model:** Not stated

## Responsibilities

The role focuses on building the backend services and agent pipelines behind TaloTrace:

- Building backend services in Python using FastAPI on Firebase and Google Cloud.
- Building agentic and multi-agent LLM systems that explore applications, generate test scenarios, and detect bugs.
- Building backend systems that are automation-friendly, test-friendly, and reliable enough for production use.
- Owning well-defined parts of the system from design through to production, and working closely with the tech lead on larger decisions.

You will not do every item below. Expect to pick up one or two at a time:

- **Scenario generation:** Turning requirements, designs, and release notes into test scenarios the agents can run.
- **Agent navigation:** Improving how agents perceive and drive web, Android, and iOS interfaces.
- **Bug detection and severity:** Deciding whether a finding is a real bug and how serious it is, so customers see the most important issues first.
- **Evidence capture:** Recording the video, logs, and reproduction steps that accompany every finding.
- **Issue routing:** Filing findings into Jira, Linear, and GitHub with enough context to act on.
- **Run orchestration:** Building the jobs, queues, and state machines that run a test suite reliably and recover when a step fails.
- **Cost and caching:** Developing run-level caching, replay, and routing between model tiers so full test suites run quickly and cheaply.
- **Evaluation harnesses:** Measuring whether a change to an agent or prompt improves or degrades results before it ships.

You will also work on everyday engineering problems: bug fixes, backend feature upgrades, integrations, test improvements, and operational reliability.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must-have technical skills**

- Hands-on experience building agentic or multi-agent LLM pipelines in Python.
- Working with multiple LLM providers in practice, such as OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), or Google (Gemini), mainly in Python.
- Proficiency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor for real implementation work, with output that holds up under code review.
- Experience with backend workflows involving jobs, state machines, retries, data validation, evaluation loops, and human review.
- Familiarity with tool calling, structured output, agent orchestration, memory, and evaluation loops.
- Experience building backend applications with FastAPI. Flask or Django is also acceptable.
- Experience with Firebase and Google Cloud services such as Cloud Run, Firestore, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Tasks, or comparable cloud services.
- A testing mindset, with attention to test quality, documentation, observability, and debuggability.
- An engineering approach to LLM non-determinism, using validation, retries, fallbacks, and quality checks rather than relying on a good run.

**Must-have soft skills and values**

- **Independence, initiative, and learning:** Learns new tools quickly, solves problems logically without supervision, and gets real results from AI-assisted coding tools.
- **Communication:** Raises problems early and clearly, including issues with code, architecture, data, or project direction.
- **Creativity:** Proposes ideas that simplify processes, test pipelines, or engineering automation.
- **Agility:** Adapts to changing requirements and follows revised plans constructively.
- **Results orientation:** Is assessed on the quality and timeliness of their output.

Candidates who learn fast with some experience are prioritized over more experienced candidates who learn slowly.

**Preferred experience**

- Browser or mobile automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or Maestro.
- GUI agents, computer-use models, or browser-driving agents.
- Using LLMs to simulate user behavior, generate tests, detect bugs, or reproduce failures.
- A background in QA or testing infrastructure.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
## Company

Firmable is a B2B sales intelligence platform in Asia Pacific with customers in the US as well. It builds a dataset about businesses, the people who work at them, and what is changing at each, consolidating records from hundreds of sources into a single record for about 15 million companies and 130 million people. The record is served to both human users and AI agents.

## Details

- **Location:** Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior
- **Working hours:** No fixed hours; high-pace startup-to-scaleup environment with a weekly release cadence moving toward daily

## Responsibilities

This role sits on a small senior team working on extraction and structuring at global scale: turning messy, inconsistent records from many sources into accurate facts about companies and people. The accuracy bar is high and the cost bar is low, because both are measured per record across billions of records.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will build the multi-step agent systems that bring new data in and turn raw records into structured, verifiable facts. This includes agents that plan across several steps, call tools, hold state, and stop for human approval before anything is committed, as well as the extraction underneath them: reliable structured output from HTML, undocumented APIs, protocol banners, and free text, where the target set is not known in advance and sources are under no obligation to be consistent.

This is a build role. You will prototype fast, then make the prototype hold at volume. The published approaches to extraction and agent reliability were not written for this volume or accuracy bar, so you will find where they fall short. Designing the replacement method and proving it works is part of the job, not a side project.

### Multi-step agent systems

- Build agents that plan across many steps, call tools, hold state between them, and stop for human approval before anything is trusted.
- Make every step observable and independently testable, with retries, idempotency, and hard budgets on cost, latency, and step count.
- Handle partial failure properly, so that a run that dies two-thirds of the way through a long job does not cost the whole job.
- Set the reliability bar for agents doing unattended work at volume, and own it when it slips.

### Extraction and structuring

- Get reliable structured output from HTML, PDF, undocumented JSON APIs, protocol banners, and free text, using constrained decoding, JSON schema enforcement, function calling, and Pydantic validation.
- Extract against an open vocabulary, where the target set is not fixed in advance. Regex and fixed signature lists are the baseline to beat, not the approach.
- Push accuracy on sources that are inconsistent, incomplete, and occasionally hostile to being parsed.
- Design new methods where existing ones fall short, and produce the evaluation that proves the new method is better.

### Building the context graphs

- Own the path from extracted entities and relationships into the graph: map them onto the schema, remove duplicates, and carry confidence through instead of dropping it at the boundary.
- Have models propose schema-constrained changes rather than write freely, with provenance attached to every fact.
- Build the review path so a human can see the diff, judge the confidence, approve or roll back a change, and trace what happened afterwards.
- Keep lineage intact end to end, so any fact can be traced back to what produced it.

### Cost, scale, and evaluation

- Keep the cost curve flat as volume grows. A method

## Company

Askable is a platform that connects experienced software engineers with contract work building AI coding tasks, which are used to measure and train AI coding models.

## Details

- **Location:** APAC (remote, any location)
- **Seniority/Level:** Not stated (listed as Software Engineer; 2+ years of professional experience required)
- **Salary:** US$1,000 per task that passes quality review
- **Work model:** Remote contract, minimum one task per week (about 10 hours per week)

## Responsibilities

You will turn a real change from a repository you know well into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

The process works as follows:

1. **Apply:** Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
2. **Propose:** Once selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. Askable approves it or suggests a better candidate.
3. **Build:** In the platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution, and the grading checks.
4. **Stress-test:** Try lazy, incorrect, and shortcut solutions, and make sure your checks catch them.
5. **Model testing:** Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
6. **Review:** A reviewer checks your task, and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
7. **Next task:** Once your task is accepted, start another.

## Requirements / Qualifications

## Responsibilities

This is a senior AI-native engineering role in which you build complete products without hand-writing production code. You work through AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex, or whatever replaces them, and you own every line that ships even though you do not type it. The job is to turn an outcome into a specification an agent can execute, provide the repository context and constraints it needs, build the conditions that let it work well, and prove the result before anything ships. You will work across the whole surface, including web, desktop, and mobile front ends, back-end services and APIs, data layers, pipelines, infrastructure, tests, and the security work around them, taking problems from outcome to production and staying close to them through operations.

- Take problems from a vague request to a running system: specification, architecture, implementation, tests, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring.
- Work across the full stack instead of waiting for a specialist (for example, a mobile screen in the morning and a Terraform module in the afternoon).
- Break work into units an agent can execute well, and recognise when the answer is a better specification, better context, or better tooling rather than another prompt.
- Own quality: review the output, design the tests, close security gaps, and monitor cost, latency, and reliability.
- Make the architecture decisions AI will not make for you, including boundaries, data models, failure behaviour, trade-offs, and what not to build at all.
- Work directly with clients and non-engineering stakeholders in English, from questioning the requirement to documenting the decision in writing.
- Turn what works into reusable assets, and help the engineers around you get better at directing agents.
- Learn new domains quickly and apply domain-specific constraints without needing a predefined playbook.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Around six years or more of building and running production software, including a product or workstream you owned end to end from delivery through operations.
- Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex on production work, with a clear view of how you configure them, what you delegate, what you keep under your control, and how you verify the result.
- Comfort with zero hand-written code as the normal way of working, where your leverage comes from specification, context, review, and verification.
- A solid foundation across the whole stack: front-end applications across web, desktop, and mobile; back-end and APIs; CI/CD; cloud infrastructure; testing strategy; and application and infrastructure security.
- No specific stack is required. You should become productive in an unfamiliar codebase, runtime, or cloud within days. Current projects use TypeScript, React, Next.js, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Electron, Python, Go, Java, Node.js, PHP, PostgreSQL, Kafka, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform, among others.
- English proficiency sufficient to run a technical discussion with a client, write a specification someone else can build from, and disagree productively in writing.
- Strong problem solving and critical thinking, including the ability to tell a plausible answer from a correct one when it comes from a model.
- A product mindset: you ask who the user is and what the business is paying for before you ask what to build.
- Experience in more than one business domain, such as ecommerce, travel, logistics, fintech, or health tech, and an understanding that each domain brings its own constraints.
- Judgement about when not to build something, when to pay down technical debt, and when an agent has gone off track.

**Nice to have:**

description:
## Details

- **Level:** L3 (Tier 3) Support Engineer
- **Working hours:** Primarily 09:00–18:00 CET, when cross-functional teams are available; L3 on-call coverage for P1 emergencies outside business hours

## Responsibilities

The L3 Support Engineer is the deep technical investigation specialist within the support organization. This role exists to permanently eliminate the root causes of recurring tickets, not to process individual incidents. L3 engineers work on the hardest problems: payroll back-calculation failures, integration breakdowns, compliance regulation misconfigurations, deployment-caused regressions, and cross-system issues that span configuration, product, and infrastructure layers.

L3 engineers do not own client accounts or manage queues. They receive escalations from Support Engineers, investigate to root cause, coordinate fixes with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Configuration teams, and close the loop by documenting findings that feed both the knowledge base and AI training data. Their success metric is not tickets resolved, but recurring issues permanently eliminated.

### Deep Technical Investigation

- Investigate complex L3 escalations, including payroll calculation failures, compliance regulation errors, integration file discrepancies, and product defects.
- Perform root cause analysis using back-calculation methodology, regulation tracing, configuration audits, and interface file analysis.
- Determine whether the root cause is configuration, compliance, product, or infrastructure.
- Validate deployment changelogs and release notes for potential regression risks, and conduct post-deployment spot checks on high-risk configurations.

### Cross-Functional Coordination

- Coordinate resolution with functional teams: create dev tasks for Product and Engineering, file compliance corrections, and work with Configuration on entity-level fixes.
- Track every L3 investigation to permanent closure, verifying fixes in production and confirming no recurrence.
- Participate in compliance training sessions as a subject matter expert, and share back-calculation techniques with Support Engineers.

### Knowledge & AI Contribution

- Document all findings in a structured format for the knowledge base, covering root cause, resolution steps, affected configurations, and prevention measures.
- Work with the AI Operations Lead to convert L3 patterns into AI training data, enabling AI to detect and flag similar issues proactively.
- Maintain a root cause register: a living document tracking all identified root causes, their status, and the ticket clusters they affect.

### Success Metrics (SMART Goals)

1. **Root Cause Elimination:** Permanently eliminate the top recurring root causes across all clients. Measured by the number of root causes fully resolved and verified in production. Target: 15 root causes permanently closed within 90 days.
2. **L3 Backlog Clearance:** Reduce the L3-eligible ticket backlog to zero aged tickets. Measured by the number of L3 tickets older than 10 business days. Target: zero aged L3 tickets within 60 days.
3. **Root Cause Register:** Establish and maintain a living root cause register tracking all identified root causes, their status, and affected ticket clusters. Measured by whether it is operational and reviewed in weekly meetings. Target: operational within 30 days.
4. **KB Documentation Rate:** Document 100% of L3 closures with full knowledge base articles covering root cause, resolution, and prevention. Measured by the percentage of L3 closures with complete KB documentation. Target: 100%, ongoing from day 1.
5. **AI Training Data Contribution:** Convert all L3 root cause patterns into structured AI training data. Measured by the percentage of L3 closures fed into the AI learning pipeline via the AI Operations Lead. Target: 100%, ongoing from day 30.
6. **Post-Deployment Validation:** Conduct spot checks on high-risk client configurations after every deployment. Measured by the percentage of deployments validated within 4 hours, using changelog analysis and automated regression check scripts. Target: 100% of deployments checked within 4 hours, starting from day

title: Senior AI Engineer (Computer Vision & Data Pipeline)
description:
## Company

VinFast is an electric vehicle (EV) manufacturer based in Vietnam. It designs and produces electric vehicles and mobility solutions for the automotive market, and is part of the Vingroup ecosystem.

## Details

- **Location:** Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior

## Responsibilities

About the role: VinFast is looking for Senior AI Engineers to build the automatic labeling and data pipeline behind its ADAS and autonomous driving program. The team turns raw multi-sensor driving data into high-quality training data at scale and closes the loop so that every human correction improves the next model. This is a full-stack AI role. You will train and evaluate computer vision models, and you will also build the pipelines, tooling, and integrations around them. The team does not split into modelers and engineers. Everyone is expected to take a problem from data through model to production pipeline, and to grow across the whole flow over time. Work is assigned according to the program's needs at the time, not by a fixed job boundary, so the team is looking for people who want breadth rather than a single specialty.

Tech stack: Python and PyTorch, Airflow for orchestration, Docker and Kubernetes, running on GPU clusters with object storage.

**Team scope.** You will contribute across all of the following over time. No one is expected to master every part on day one, but you should be willing to work in any of them:
- Computer vision models over camera and LiDAR data: detection, segmentation, and tracking
- Automatic pre-labeling with confidence scoring, and routing work between machine and human review
- Automated data pipelines that run the full flow end to end at production volume
- Integration with annotation tooling, and conversion of data into standard training and simulation formats
- Mining the data archive for the scenarios and edge cases that matter most

**Models & Evaluation**
- Train, fine-tune, and evaluate computer vision models on large multi-sensor datasets
- Measure model quality with standard metrics, and drive targeted improvement from error analysis
- Apply human-in-the-loop techniques: pre-labeling, confidence scoring, and feedback from human corrections

**Data & Pipelines**
- Build and operate automated pipelines that process data end to end at production volume
- Prepare and manage datasets: cleaning, splitting, augmentation, versioning, and format conversion
- Ensure pipelines are reproducible, observable, and recoverable, with no silent failures

**Collaboration & Delivery**
- Work with the annotation team so that labeling standards match what the models actually need
- Partner with the platform team to deploy models and pipelines into production
- Document workflows and data contracts so other teams can use the output without asking

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Required**
- 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning, computer vision, or data engineering
- Strong Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow)
- Solid experience training and evaluating computer vision models in production, not only in research
- Experience building automated data pipelines with Airflow or a similar orchestrator
- Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, and working on GPU clusters
- Experience with large-scale datasets and with imperfect labels
- Willingness to work across the full flow (model, pipeline, and integration) rather than within a single specialty
- Good communication in English, for technical documentation and for working with international partners

**Nice to Have**
- Experience with 3D data: LiDAR point clouds, 3D object detection, sensor fusion, or multi-camera calibration
- Experience with annotation tools such as CVAT or Label Studio, including customizing or extending them
- Familiarity with autonomous driving datasets (nuScenes, KITTI, Waymo) or simulation data formats
- Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, model registry, and inference serving
- Contributions to open-source ML projects, or publications in computer vision

## Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Premium healthcare package, including PVI insurance and annual health check-ups
- 13th-month salary and performance bonuses
- Preferential pricing for services within the Vingroup ecosystem, including Vinmec, Vinpearl, and Vinschool
- Opportunity to collaborate with and learn from industry-leading professionals in the automotive domain

description:
## Company

- Establish guidelines for federated context routing and token-budget allocation across sources.
- Contribute to an ontology proof of concept covering one domain and one workflow using YAML-based schemas.
- Validate integration with internal or external agent platforms, including access and smoke testing.
- Capture pilot evidence and contribute to the standard and company best-practices package.

**Success outcomes**

- Context architecture, format, and evaluation standards are validated through representative pilots.
- Pilot teams can convert source knowledge and author evaluation fixtures using documented playbooks.
- A working repo-native harness POC demonstrates repeatable benchmark execution and quality gates.
- The committee has sufficient evidence to ratify the standard and decide whether to adopt or build the long-term harness.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Context engineering skills**

- **RAG and retrieval pipelines:** Design advanced search and retrieval systems that supply models with accurate, relevant, and timely information.
- **Context-window and token management:** Compress conversation history, prioritize useful context, and filter noise to optimize model attention and cost.
- **Memory architecture:** Build short-term and persistent memory systems that allow agents to retain state across tasks and interactions.
- **Instruction curation:** Structure plain-English operating rules, Markdown files, domain guides, and other instructions for dynamic injection into agent tasks.
- **Context formats and knowledge modeling:** Design context layers and reusable knowledge assets using Markdown, YAML, schemas, and related formats.

**Harness engineering skills**

- **Tool and MCP integration:** Connect models to external APIs, execution environments, tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- **Sandboxing and permissions:** Define safety boundaries, access controls, approval flows, and secure execution environments for agent actions.
- **Validation and guardrails:** Implement linters, automated tests, evaluations, and verification layers that detect hallucinations, policy violations, or broken code.
- **Orchestration and control loops:** Design multi-step workflows, retry logic, state transitions, and error-correction loops for long-horizon tasks.
- **Evaluation harnesses:** Build fixtures, benchmark tasks, quality gates, and CI-integrated evaluations using DeepEval, Promptfoo, or comparable frameworks.

**Supporting technical and leadership skills**

- **LLM and agent fundamentals:** Strong understanding of agent workflows, RAG, evaluation methods, and quality gates for AI-generated output.
- **Software engineering:** Strong Git/GitHub and CI practices

- Author and maintain knowledge base articles for common issues and resolutions. Every resolved ticket contributes to the KB and AI training dataset.

- Tag 100% of resolved tickets with structured resolution data for AI learning.

**24/7 Coverage**

- Participate in shift rotation for 24/7 coverage as scheduled.
- Handle cross-client tickets during off-peak shifts when primary account owners are off-shift.
- Follow structured shift handover protocols.

**Performance Goals**

1. **SLA Compliance:** Achieve and maintain 95% or higher SLA compliance on all owned tickets across all priority levels, ongoing from day 1.
2. **Client Ticket Volume Reduction:** Reduce ticket creation volume for assigned clients by 25% within 90 days, measured month-over-month per client, by identifying recurring issues, escalating root causes to L3, and working with Product teams on permanent fixes.

- Minimum 2 years in SaaS product support, HRIS support, or payroll operations.

## Responsibilities

We are looking for a Python AI Engineer to help build and advance our AI Indexing & Search Pipeline. You will design and implement end-to-end pipelines for data crawling, content processing, vector embedding generation, and indexing to power high-performance semantic search.

**Pipeline Development & Core Architecture**

**Data Crawling & Processing**

**AI Models & Search Engine Integration**

- Use OpenAI Embeddings for content vectorization.
- Integrate and manage Elasticsearch 8.x for vector storage and search, working extensively with 1536-dimensional dense_vector fields and the Korean Nori Analyzer.
- Use FAISS for local vector search experiments and rapid prototyping.

**Batch, State & Reliability Management**

- Design and implement mechanisms for Incremental Indexing and Full Re-indexing.
- Manage incremental batch states using Redis.
- Track batch execution history and metadata using PostgreSQL.
- Implement robust retry mechanisms and error-handling logic to ensure high system reliability.

**Scheduling, Deployment & Operations**

- Configure automated job scheduling using APScheduler or Linux Crontab.
- Deploy and operate batch applications on Linux environments using systemd and Python virtual environments (venv).
- Perform logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting for batch job operations.
- Collaborate closely with Backend, AI, and DevOps team members to deploy and scale system operations.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Core Experience & Technical Skills**

- 2–4+ years of strong hands-on development experience in Python.
- Proficiency in web scraping and crawling libraries (e.g., BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, or Selenium).
- Practical experience with Elasticsearch 8.x, specifically Vector Search, dense_vector, kNN search, and custom analyzer configurations such as Nori.
- Deep understanding of, and hands-on experience with, embedding models (e.g., OpenAI Embeddings, HuggingFace) and text chunking/preprocessing techniques.
- Ability to understand business logic, design solutions, and lead development.

**Core Technical Stack**

- Proficiency in Python and C++ (essential for high-performance edge deployment and runtime integration).

- Deep understanding of memory management, hardware acceleration (CPU/GPU/NPU), and latency reduction strategies for edge devices.

**NLP & Recommendation Systems**

- Strong command of NLP pipelines: tokenization, embeddings, vector search, semantic retrieval, and fine-tuning lightweight transformer architectures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss, Chroma) for semantic recommendation lookups.
- Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks or lightweight LLM deployment on local hardware.
- Background in cybersecurity principles, data privacy compliance, or secure code delivery practices.

## Benefits

- **Hands-On Technical Work:** Work on challenging problems at the intersection of edge computing, NLP, and distributed architecture.
- **High Impact:** Your code and architectural decisions will directly shape core products used across the company's enterprise ecosystem.
- **Growth & Autonomy:** A collaborative environment that supports technical exploration, continuous learning, and ownership.

description:
## Company

TaloTrace is an AI-powered QA platform that autonomously tests web and mobile applications, discovers issues, and produces evidence-backed findings for engineering teams. Each reported issue includes recorded video, logs, reproduction steps, severity, and supporting evidence.

## Details

- **Location:** Vietnam (remote; work can be done from anywhere in Vietnam)
- **Seniority/Level:** Not specified. Open to students, freelancers, working professionals, recent graduates, and career changers. No AI or computer science background required for general tasks.
- **Work model:** Remote, task-based, part-time or supplemental. Task volume varies, with no guaranteed hours, task volumes, or earnings.

## Responsibilities

**Software test run review**
- Watch recordings of an AI agent testing a website or mobile app, step by step.
- Compare what happened on screen with the expected result for each step, and mark each step as passed, failed, or not reached.
- Decide whether the overall test achieved its goal.
- When a test fails, choose the most likely cause (such as a mistake by the agent, a problem with the app, or bad test data) and explain what you saw.
- Flag test cases that are unclear, impossible to complete, or duplicated.

**Bug report review**
- Review bugs reported by an AI system and decide whether each one is a genuine defect.
- Check each bug's severity against the project's severity guidelines, from critical to minor.
- Match reported bugs to a list of known bugs, and note any real bugs that were missed.
- Identify the exact moment in a video where a bug appears.

**Test scenario and test data review**
- Compare original test cases with the versions imported into the company's system, and check that nothing was lost or changed in meaning.
- Check that each test case has the accounts, data, and starting conditions it needs to run.
- Review conversations in which the system asked for missing information, and judge whether it asked the right questions.

**Product knowledge review**
- Compare business rules and user flows extracted by the system against the original documents or screens.
- Mark each rule as correct, partly correct, or wrong, and add any important rules that were missed.

**Clear and detailed feedback**
- Apply the evaluation rubric consistently rather than relying on personal preference.
- Explain errors precisely enough that another reviewer can understand what went wrong and why.
- Check your work before submitting and maintain accuracy across repeated tasks.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Must be based in Vietnam.
- Can read and follow instructions carefully.
- Has strong attention to detail and can identify errors or inconsistencies.
- Can make objective decisions based on stated criteria.
- Can explain reasoning clearly in English or Vietnamese, depending on the project. Fluency in both is not required for every project; apply based on the language(s) you can work in. Some projects have additional language or subject requirements, which are stated per project.
- Can work independently, manage time, and meet task deadlines.
- Has a computer and reliable internet access.
- Experience in software testing or quality assurance is a strong plus. Comfort using websites and mobile apps and noticing when something does not work as expected is also valued.

**Application and qualification process**
1. Submit your CV, contact details, language capabilities, and relevant skills or experience. The CV is checked to confirm you are based in Vietnam.
2. Eligible applicants receive a private link to the labelling portal.
3. Complete the Level 0 qualification test on the portal. This is the single assessment round used to determine whether you may proceed for a specific benchmark queue. Test format: generally 5–10 questions drawn from a larger question bank. All questions must be answered correctly,

## Company

- **Development:** Design, build, and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python.
- **Architecture:** Engineer the integration of open source software from boot firmware to cloud application deployment.
- **Packaging:** Package software using a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship it in the distribution.
- **Automation:** Build and maintain the systems that build, test, and ship Ubuntu.
- **Distro Engineering:** Maintain and evolve a Linux distribution and its repositories.

Day-to-day, engineers will:

- Design, build, and ship software in Rust, Go, and Python.

Engineers may join one of four teams that ship Ubuntu:

- **Foundations:** Maintains foundational software, including architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems, and core utilities.
- **Server:** Leads the design, evolution, and future of the Ubuntu Server distribution.
- **Desktop:** Drives Ubuntu Desktop, the future immutable desktop (Ubuntu Core Desktop), WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern desktop applications built with Flutter.
- **Debcrafters:** Responsible for the forward movement, maintenance, and overall health of the Ubuntu archive, one of the most extensive open source software repositories available.

Based on first-round interviews, candidates are matched to specific teams for second-round interviews.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering.
- Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms.

- **Compensation:** Pay is set

description:
## Company

Zalo is a Vietnamese messaging and social networking platform operated by VNG Corporation.

## Details

## Responsibilities

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) role requires a blend of low-level system engineering skills and a solid SRE mindset. You will use software engineering principles and code to build automation platforms, optimize disk and network I/O, and maintain high-scale distributed systems with high availability and ultra-low latency at millions of QPS.

**Internal Platform & Systems Engineering**

- Design and develop deep observability systems, including high-cardinality metrics, distributed tracing, and large-scale logging.
- Design and develop automation toolkits, including control planes, custom Kubernetes operators, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), to drive toil elimination.
- Research, design, and optimize low-level system performance (disk I/O, network stack, Linux kernel tuning) for large-scale distributed services.

**Production Operations & Incident Response**

- Take ownership of the availability, latency, and scalability of production services using SLOs/SLIs and error budgets.
- Foster a resilience-for-failure mindset by leading incident response for complex production issues.
- Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and facilitate blameless postmortems to prevent recurrence.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 3+ years of software engineering experience working directly with low-level system components such as disk I/O, network stack, and memory management, using systems programming languages (C++, Go, Java, or Rust).
- Distributed systems: strong understanding of consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos), replication topologies, data partitioning (sharding / consistent hashing), the CAP theorem, and consistency models (eventual vs. strong consistency).
- Linux kernel: deep understanding of kernel internals, including virtual memory, page cache, I/O schedulers, system calls, and process/thread management.
- Networking: proficiency with the TCP/IP stack, socket programming, HTTP/gRPC, load balancing, and network latency optimization at the transport and application layers.
- Observability: in-depth knowledge of observability architecture and tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger), including handling high-cardinality metrics and large-scale logging and tracing.
- SRE mindset: "operations as code" approach, reliability management via metrics (SLO/SLI, error budgets), toil elimination, and automated safety guardrails (progressive rollout, zero-touch production).

**Nice to have**

- Strong algorithmic and data structure thinking, with a proven ability to solve complex data structure and algorithmic optimization problems in distributed systems.
- Proficiency with kernel-level diagnostic and profiling tools such as eBPF, perf, bcc-tools, and sysctl.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (including writing custom Kubernetes operators), and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform/Ansible).

The role plays a key part in vulnerability management, incident response, and security monitoring, and ensures compliance with internal and international standards.

**Security Architecture & Implementation**

- Design and maintain secure architectures for AWS and on-premises environments, implementing security groups, IAM policies, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and WAF configurations.
- Integrate CDN and WAF providers such as Cloudflare, EdgeNext, and CDNetworks for DDoS mitigation, bot management, and web-application protection.

- Maintain continuous cloud security posture management (CSPM) and configuration-drift monitoring (e.g., AWS Config) across AWS accounts.
- Classify and monitor sensitive data at rest (e.g., AWS Macie) to support DLP coverage in the cloud.
- Own privileged access management (PAM) and secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), including MFA and just-in-time access for sensitive systems.

**Application Security & DevSecOps**

- Integrate SAST, DAST, and software composition analysis (SCA) into the GitLab CI/CD pipeline to catch vulnerabilities before release.

**Threat Intelligence & Monitoring**

- Continuously assess new and emerging threats affecting the company's infrastructure and cloud footprint.

**Data Loss Prevention (DLP) & Compliance**

- Investigate, validate, and classify DLP alerts to ensure proper escalation of potential data leaks.
- Work with managers and department heads to validate incidents, document findings, and implement corrective actions.
- Ensure adherence to security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, GDPR).
- Develop and maintain incident validation and DLP record-keeping templates for audits and reporting.

**Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)**

- Plan, perform, and document vulnerability assessments and penetration tests across both on-premises and cloud systems.
- Coordinate remediation activities with Network, Systems, and DevOps teams to ensure timely patching of identified vulnerabilities.
- Use tools such as Nessus, OpenVAS, Metasploit, Burp Suite, and AWS Inspector to assess infrastructure and application security posture.
- Track vulnerabilities and mitigation status through centralized dashboards and weekly reports.

## Company

## Details

- **Seniority/Level:** Engineer through Principal Engineer (up to Principal level)
- **Salary:** Not stated
- **Work model:** Not stated

## Responsibilities

The SoC Design organization is seeking engineers to contribute to the implementation and front-end readiness of complex SoC, subsystem, and IP designs. The role focuses on design constraints, synthesis, timing analysis, power-intent implementation, and implementation collateral needed to deliver high-quality netlists to downstream Physical Design, Design Verification, DFT, emulation, and signoff teams.

The successful candidate will work closely with RTL Design, SoC Architecture, Design Verification, Physical Design, DFT, CAD/methodology, power-management, and program teams across the global engineering organization. The role requires a strong understanding of the transformation from RTL to synthesized netlist, including constraint development, synthesis optimization, timing and QoR analysis, low-power implementation using UPF, and resolution of design issues across RTL, constraints, libraries, tools, and flow configuration.

### Design Implementation and Front-End Readiness

- Support implementation of complex SoC, subsystem, and IP designs from RTL through synthesis and handoff to downstream implementation teams.
- Review RTL hierarchy, design partitioning, clock and reset architecture, interface definitions, and implementation requirements.
- Prepare and maintain synthesis scripts, design configuration, file lists, libraries, operating conditions, scenarios, and implementation collateral.
- Coordinate design releases, dependencies, configuration updates, and implementation readiness across RTL, DV, DFT, PD, CAD, and architecture teams.
- Analyze design quality and identify RTL, constraint, library, or flow issues affecting timing, power, area, reliability, or implementation convergence.
- Support design reviews, implementation reviews, signoff reviews, and technical documentation activities.
- Investigate failures across RTL, synthesis, constraints, UPF, libraries, tool setup, and build environments; identify root cause and drive corrective action.

### Constraint Development and Timing Readiness

The role is customer-facing and supports customers across the product lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) and process validation through manufacturing ramp and high-volume production. Key responsibilities include:

1. **Customer Technical Support**
   - Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support for Keysight's High-Speed Digital, Optical, and RF/Microwave solutions.
   - Serve as the primary technical interface for customers across manufacturing, process engineering, quality engineering, and R&D organizations.
   - Understand customer manufacturing and test challenges and recommend appropriate test solutions and methodologies.
   - Assist customers with system installation, configuration, integration, and deployment.

2. **Manufacturing and Production Test Applications**
   - Support production test, NPI, and manufacturing deployment activities for:
     - Optical transceivers (400G, 800G, 1.6T)
     - Active and passive cable interconnects
     - High-speed digital interfaces (PAM4, NRZ)
     - Ethernet and PCIe technologies
     - RF/microwave components and subsystems, including RF power amplifiers, filters, duplexers and multiplexers, mixers, converters, and RF front-end modules
     - Semiconductor and electronics manufacturing applications
   - Help customers establish efficient and repeatable test methodologies for high-volume manufacturing.
   - Support test station development, automation, validation, and manufacturing release.

3. **Yield Improvement and Test Optimization**
   - Analyze measurement results and support troubleshooting of yield, correlation, and test repeatability issues.
   - Assist customers in identifying root causes of production problems affecting throughput, quality, and cost.
   - Recommend best practices to reduce test time while maintaining measurement integrity.
   - Support gauge studies, correlation analysis, GR&R activities, and test system qualification.

4. **Solution Deployment and Automation**
   - Develop and support automated test solutions using Keysight instrumentation and software platforms.
   - Create test procedures, application notes, work instructions, and deployment documentation.
   - Assist customers with automation, data collection, and manufacturing database integration.
   - Support implementation of statistical process control (SPC) and manufacturing analytics methodologies.

5. **RF/Microwave Technical Support**
   - Support customer applications involving S-parameter characterization, network analysis, spectrum analysis, signal generation, vector signal analysis, RF component characterization, and antenna and wireless device testing.
   - Guide customers on calibration techniques, measurement uncertainty, and best measurement practices.
   - Troubleshoot RF measurement and production test challenges.

6. **Business and Team Collaboration**
   - Work closely with sales teams to identify customer opportunities and support technical engagements.
   - Participate in customer demonstrations, evaluations, and proof-of-concept activities.
   - Collaborate with product management and R&D teams to communicate customer requirements and market trends.
   - Maintain awareness of industry developments in AI datacenter technologies, optical communications, wireless connectivity, and electronics manufacturing.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- 3 to 8 years of experience in Applications Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Product Engineering, or Technical Support.
- Experience working with test and measurement instrumentation in a manufacturing, engineering, or laboratory environment.
- Previous experience with a test and measurement equipment supplier or electronics manufacturing company is highly desirable.
- Understanding of at least one of the following areas:
  - Optical communications
  - High-speed digital systems
  - RF/microwave engineering
- Familiarity with production test methodologies and manufacturing processes.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Experience with automation tools and scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, C/C++, LabVIEW, or similar.
- Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.
- Mandarin language capability is advantageous due to regional customer interactions.
- Willingness to travel within Vietnam and internationally

## Company

Mobio Vietnam Software Application Joint Stock Company is a Vietnamese software company that develops and sells its products as Software as a Service (SaaS). Its main product is a Customer Data Platform (CDP) that consolidates and analyzes customer data to optimize and automate Marketing, Sales, and Service workflows. Its three product lines are Activation CDP (digital marketing), Smart CRM (sales and service teams), and Analytic CDP (data engineers and data scientists). Its customers are mainly large enterprises in banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, and retail.

## Details

## Responsibilities

Mobio offers its software on a subscription basis, but most large customers, especially banks, require deployment on infrastructure they manage. The same product must therefore run reliably on four deployment models: SaaS, On-Premise, Hybrid, and Cloud Native. Some environments have no internet access and strict security constraints. The product also ships a new version every two weeks, while the number of On-Premise installations keeps growing.

The DevOps Engineer is directly responsible for keeping the platform running correctly and reliably. This covers building and operating Kubernetes clusters and data services, maintaining the delivery pipeline from code to customer environments, maintaining monitoring that accurately reflects system health, and handling infrastructure incidents.

This is not a role that only follows instructions. The company expects you to identify manual steps and proactively propose ways to eliminate them. Over time, you will take on more responsibility for design, standardization, and handover, which is the path to Senior.

The role sits in the DevOps Team, which builds and owns the infrastructure platform and packages its processes, tools, and documentation for handover. Success is measured by whether team members or customers can operate what you hand over without you.

You will also work with:
- **Development Teams:** receive requests for environments, pipelines, and resources, and give feedback on designs that are hard to operate (for example, missing health probes, logs that are hard to search, or hard-coded configuration).
- **Solution Delivery Team:** provide technical support during customer-impacting incidents, deploy new installations, assess customer infrastructure, and travel domestically or internationally when needed.

**1. Operating and deploying the Kubernetes platform and data services (35%)**
- Build new Kubernetes clusters and operate running clusters (nodes, workloads, resources, certificates, version upgrades).
- Operate data services outside the cluster: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, StarRocks, HDFS, Qdrant, and NFS (configuration, capacity expansion, troubleshooting).
- Operate Operators: Flink Operator (CDC jobs), Spark Operator, and KEDA.
- Deploy new releases on the two

**Education & Experience**
- Vocational secondary degree or higher (per the posting header). The job description specifies a college or university degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Multimedia Communications, or a related field.

**Technical Skills**
- Advanced Excel skills: proficient in calculation and lookup functions (VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, PivotTables, IF, etc.), with an analytical approach to accounting receivables data.
- IT skills: understanding of hardware, computer networks, and troubleshooting office software.
- Branding & content skills: strong writing and editing ability, basic photography skills, and good aesthetic sense.
- Tools: basic proficiency with design and photo-editing software (Photoshop, Canva, Illustrator, etc.) and experience managing a CMS website (e.g., WordPress).

**Attitude & Personal Qualities**
- Careful and detail-oriented in handling data and managing equipment.
- Quick-thinking, highly responsible, and proactive in supporting other departments.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary (12–16 million VND/month, negotiable based on competence) plus performance bonuses and KPI-based incentives.
- Full social insurance, health insurance, and unemployment insurance, in accordance with the Labor Law.
- 13th-month salary bonus, holiday and Tết bonuses, an annual company trip, and team-building activities (subject to the company's business performance).
- A dynamic, open work environment where you can develop a range of skills across technical, data, and creative areas.

- *Willingness:* You have not worked this way yet but want to. The company will teach you, and you are comfortable spending most of your time specifying, reviewing, and verifying rather than typing code.

In both cases, you are expected to:

- Describe a task clearly: the goal, the constraints, and how to tell it is done.
- Treat agent output as a draft from a fast but careless colleague: read

The Project Assistant (Back-End) is responsible for managing the complete set of documents and records for the Center's projects, from bid preparation and contract execution through acceptance and liquidation. The role also serves as the point of contact for the Center's internal administrative and logistics work, to keep the Center running efficiently and in compliance with regulations.

**2. Contract Management and Monitoring (Implementation stage)**

**3. Acceptance, Payment, and Contract Liquidation (Closing stage)**

- Draft contract liquidation minutes, complete the procedures to return performance and warranty guarantees, and close the project file.

**4. Project Document Management**
- Establish a systematic filing system for all project documents, covering both hard copies at the office and soft copies on the shared data system.
- Ensure documents are secure, easy to retrieve, and legally complete, to support audits, inspections, or reconciliation when required.

**5. Center Administration**
- Manage official correspondence: receive, sort, route, and file incoming and outgoing official letters, submissions, and internal decisions of the Center.
- Office logistics: book taxis; manage and issue stationery, work equipment, and tools to Center staff.
- Internal events: support coordination and logistics for meetings, workshops, client visits, and internal engagement or communication activities.
- Attendance and benefits: support tracking of working days and leave schedules, and coordinate with the HR department on employee benefits for Center staff.

**6. Other Duties**
- Perform other tasks as directly assigned by the Center Director.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education**
- University degree or higher in a relevant field.

**Experience**
- At least 1 year of experience in an equivalent position.
- Experience in bidding in the telecommunications, IT, or low-voltage electrical sectors is preferred.

**Hard Skills**
- Proficient in office software

- Use AI-assisted development tools in daily work, and share effective practices with the team.

- At least one CV model taken to production, with a clear account of its performance and the changes made after go-live.
- Practical knowledge of model optimisation and deployment: ONNX, TensorRT or OpenVINO, Docker, and exposing models through REST/gRPC APIs.
- Good engineering habits: Git, code review, testing, and reproducible experiments (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC).
- Fluent English, spoken and written. You will join client calls, present results, and write technical documentation in English without a translator.

## Benefits

- Competitive, negotiable salary based on experience and skills.
- Salary reviewed annually.
- 13 months' salary per year.

- Opportunity to join a global team and work directly with talented people around the world.
- Work and grow with a passionate, young, and talented team.

Design, deploy, and operate the company's hybrid infrastructure across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premise environments, ensuring reliability, security, and release velocity. Build and maintain CI/CD, container orchestration, and observability systems that support fast, safe product releases in both environments. Work cross-functionally with Backend, QA, and Security teams, and with the Infrastructure Lead, to standardize release, rollback, and security practices.

**A. Cloud & On-Premise Infrastructure Operations**

- Design, deploy, and operate cloud-native infrastructure on AWS/GCP, and support on-premise infrastructure (Linux servers, virtualization, storage, load balancing), ensuring performance, availability, and scalability.
- Support hybrid connectivity between on-premise and cloud (Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect) and workload migration between environments.
- Optimize operating costs through cost monitoring and efficient resource usage.

**B. CI/CD & Container Orchestration**

- Build and maintain an optimized CI/CD system that ensures release quality and speed.
- Lead the deployment and management of container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) on both EKS and on-premise clusters, with autoscaling and self-healing capability.
- Manage container registries and image lifecycle (e.g., Harbor, ECR) and standardize deployment templates (Terraform modules, Helm charts).

**C. Observability & Reliability**

- Set up monitoring and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Sentry) across cloud and on-premise environments to ensure system reliability (SLA/SLO).
- Collaborate with Backend, QA, and Security teams to standardize release, rollback, and versioning processes.

**D. Security**

- Propose and implement system security policies, including secret management and access control (IAM, Vault, SSO), consistently across cloud and on-premise environments.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Minimum 4 years of experience as a DevOps Engineer. Experience at a SaaS company or with microservices architecture is a plus.
- College degree or higher (Cao Đẳng trở lên).

- Administer physical servers, virtual servers, and data storage systems.
- Manage the camera system, telephone switchboard, time-attendance machines, and other IT equipment.
- Monitor and assess IT infrastructure, and propose upgrades that match the school's development needs.

**Software System Administration**

**Database Administration and Security**

- Check for and guard against viruses, malware, and other information security risks.
- Monitor system logs and handle security incidents as they arise.

**User Support**
- Provide technical support to teachers and staff for computers, printers, software, and IT equipment.
- Resolve incidents promptly so that teaching and school operations are not disrupted.
- Guide and train teachers and staff in using technology.

**Digital Transformation and System Development**
- Research and propose digital transformation solutions for the school.
- Help prepare management data reports for the School Board and Executive Board.
- Take part in technology projects, including AI and automation of school management processes.
- Integrate data across software systems to improve management efficiency and data use.

**IT Asset Management**
- Track, inventory, and manage the school's IT assets.
- Plan regular maintenance, repair, and replacement of equipment.
- Propose IT equipment purchases to support school operations.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Minimum 3 years of professional experience.
- University degree or higher in IT, Information Systems, Computer Networking, or an equivalent field.
- Experience administering networks, servers, and Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
- Knowledge of databases, information security, and data backup.
- Priority given to candidates with experience deploying school management, ERP, MISA, or LMS software.
- Strong service orientation and user-support skills, with initiative and a high sense of responsibility.

## Benefits

- Total fixed income of 15–25 million VND per month.
- Shift meal allowance, in accordance with school regulations.

- Full work equipment provided.
- Annual health check-up.
- One summer trip per year.
- Holiday and Tết bonuses, in accordance with school policy.

IPA Group (CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN TẬP ĐOÀN ĐẦU TƯ I.P.A) is a Vietnamese investment holding group. Its businesses span digital infrastructure (IPA Solution), consumer and lifestyle services (IPA Living, including the AnVie, VNDGO and PTICare brands), and capital and investment management (IPA Management). ## Responsibilities

The CTO is the group-level technology leader. The role is responsible for building the long-term technology architecture, developing the technology organization, and serving as strategic technology advisor to the Board of Directors on technology, data and AI decisions.

**1. Platform architecture**
- Design and lead the architecture of IPAS, the integrated Data Intelligence Platform.
- Build the technology roadmap that supports the group's long-term strategy.
- Decide on build-versus-buy strategy for critical technology components.
- Set standards for data, system integration and scalability.
- Build the AI/ML platform, including:
  - Model Lifecycle Management
  - Feature Store

**2. Group digital infrastructure**

  - DTOS (Digital Transformation & Optimization System)
  - DGOS (Digital Governance & Operations System)
  - FSS (Financial Sector Solutions)
- Ensure these platforms operate in a coordinated way, scale effectively, and meet the governance requirements of each business sector.

**3. Technology organization**
- Build and develop the group-level technology organization.
- Recruit and develop the next generation of technology leaders.
- Establish technical culture, operating standards and governance mechanisms suited to a large organization.
- Create an environment that attracts and retains outstanding technology talent.

**4. Strategic relationships**

- Take part in technology due diligence for investment and M&A transactions.
- Advise the Board of Directors on technology, data and AI strategy.

**5. Senior governance**
- Take part in the group's long-term strategic planning.
- Support the Board of Directors on major technology investment decisions.
- Build technology capability as a long-term competitive advantage for IPA Group.

description:
## Company

Công ty Cổ phần Công nghiệp KIMSEN (KIMSEN Industrial Joint Stock Company) is an industrial company operating a production facility in Bắc Ninh. Its work includes developing and manufacturing electrical equipment, including power converters and smart EV charging equipment.
