- **Level:** Staff (Nhân viên)
- **Experience:** 1 year
- **Education:** University degree or higher
- **Salary:** 15–20 million VND (starting salary after official hiring; negotiable for candidates with outstanding skills or experience)
- **Work model:** On-site (office / onsite)
- **Employment type:** Full-time
- **Working hours:** Monday–Saturday, 08:00–17:00; two Saturdays off per month

## Responsibilities

1. **Device control programming:** Write embedded C source code for microcontrollers (MCUs) to control the operation of power converters and smart EV charging equipment.
2. **MCU peripheral configuration:** Configure timers to generate PWM signals that drive power circuits, and configure ADC converters to accurately measure current, voltage, and temperature.
3. **CAN network communication:** Program the transmission, reception, and processing of data over the CAN bus to enable reliable communication between the charger and the battery management system (BMS) in the electric vehicle.
4. **State machine design and real-time protection:** Build state machines to manage the device's operating modes, and implement real-time interrupt logic for emergency shutdown when faults are detected (overvoltage, overcurrent, overtemperature).
5. **Firmware flashing and debugging in the lab:** Flash software directly onto physical boards, use an oscilloscope to verify drive and trigger signals, and work with hardware engineers to resolve issues.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- At least 1 year of relevant professional experience.
- University degree or higher in Electrical–Electronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics and Telecommunications, or Information Technology.
- Specialization in Embedded Engineering / embedded programming.
- Strong command of Embedded C, including proficiency with pointers, data structures (struct, enum), interrupt management, and techniques to prevent MCU lock-ups.
- Understanding of how to configure core peripherals: timers, PWM generation, sensor reading via ADC, and serial communication (UART, SPI, I2C).
- Experience with finite state machine (FSM) programming to manage device operating modes and processing flow.
- Experience programming CAN bus communication or basic industrial communication protocols.
- Ability to read electronic schematics to determine where microcontroller pins connect in the circuit.
- Familiarity with basic lab equipment: oscilloscope (for viewing waveforms), multimeter, and programmers/debuggers such as J-Link and ST-Link.

title: [Hanoi] Senior Automation & AI System Engineer
company: ZEDER VIỆT NAM
description:
## Company

Zeder Corporation (ZEDER VIỆT NAM) runs an Automation and AI team in Hanoi that builds process automation across its business systems, including NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics Navision, Magento 2, Freshsales, Freshdesk, Stripe, Google BigQuery, Twilio and Asana. The team works directly with English-speaking stakeholders in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.

## Details

- **Location:** Hà Đông District, Hanoi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior (Chuyên viên cấp cao)
- **Openings:** 2

## Responsibilities

The role is a senior, hands-on engineering position. You will take a business problem, scope it with the people who own the process, and then build and ship the solution yourself. The work spans three areas: conventional automation and system integration, agentic automation, and LLM-assisted automation. A large part of the job is knowing which of the three a given problem calls for.

### Scoping and Requirements

- Meet with department stakeholders to understand the process, the problem and the outcome they actually need.
- Map current-state processes and identify where automation delivers real value rather than automating waste.
- Write clear scoping documents covering requirements, proposed approach, systems and data involved, effort estimate and success measures.
- Recommend the right approach for each project, whether a platform workflow, an agentic system, an LLM-assisted step or a code solution.
- Push back on requests where automation is not the right answer, and explain your reasoning.

### Engineering and Delivery

- Build, test and deploy automations end to end, from approved scope through to production and handover.
- Design integrations across our systems using REST APIs, webhooks and file-based transfers, including authentication, rate limiting, pagination, retries and data mapping.
- Write production JavaScript and Python for logic that a platform cannot handle properly.
- Build systems that hold up in production: idempotent operations, sensible retry and backoff, queueing, dead-letter handling, and failure states that alert someone rather than failing silently.
- Model and manage the data behind multi-step processes, including state, queues and reconciliation.
- Work with the existing stack: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics Navision, Magento 2, Freshsales, Freshdesk, Stripe, Google BigQuery, Twilio and Asana.

### Tooling

- Build on n8n, the primary automation platform, wherever the platform can genuinely do the job. Platform-based workflows must be visible, supportable and maintainable by more than one person.
- Write code only when the platform is the wrong tool. Any code you write must be production-grade: version controlled, documented, tested and deployable by someone other than you.

### AI and Agentic Systems

- Build agentic workflows that combine planning, tool use and decision-making using LLMs.
- Integrate LLMs into business processes for classification, extraction, summarisation, document routing, drafting and decision support.
- Treat prompts as production assets: versioned, tested, and managed with attention to context, structured outputs and tool definitions.
- Manage agent memory and state across multi-step actions. Design guardrails, validation and human review points where the cost of an error is high.
- Evaluate output quality using a defined method rather than impression, and monitor it after launch.
- Treat token cost and latency as first-class design constraints.
- Recognise when an LLM is the wrong tool and use ordinary code instead.

### Reliability, Documentation and Support

- Own the reliability of what you build, including monitoring, logging, alerting and error handling.
- Maintain technical documentation and runbooks in Confluence so others can support the automations

The Senior QA Specialist ensures quality for projects, systems, and IT changes from requirements analysis, design, development, and testing through to production deployment. The role reports to the QA Lead / Head of System Planning and sits within the System Planning / Quality Assurance function.

The role acts as an independent quality control point between Business, Business Analysts (BA), Development, Vendors, Project Managers / PMO, and Operations. It ensures changes are delivered as required, fully tested, risk-controlled, and meet quality standards before Go-Live.

### A. Quality Assurance & Quality Governance

  - Business Requirements / BRD
  - Functional Specification / FSD
  - Technical Specification

  - Go-Live Plan / Cutover Plan
- Assess whether requirements are complete and appropriate before they move to Development or Testing.
- Monitor compliance with the SDLC process and internal control requirements.
- Define quality control points and quality gates at each project stage.

### B. Test Management & Test Quality

- Review the Test Strategy, Test Plan, and Test Cases for each project.
- Ensure test coverage is appropriate for business requirements and system impacts.
- Review SIT/UAT results and assess outstanding defects.
- Track the defect lifecycle, classify severity, and assess impact.
- Verify retesting and regression testing before defects are closed.

## Company

SalesNow Inc. is a Japanese company that builds its own B2B sales-intelligence product for the Japanese market. Its platform compiles corporate data from many sources, including company profiles, job postings, investor relations materials, services and technology stacks, advertising, organizational structure, and contact information. It tracks company activity signals such as hiring surges, fundraising, new offices, overseas expansion, forecast cuts, and removed job postings. Customers, mainly sales teams at large companies and listed companies, use this data to decide which companies to approach and when. Data is delivered through the SalesNow web application, Salesforce and HubSpot integrations, a Data API, and an MCP server for AI agents. The company has three Vietnamese team members and plans to hire 5 to 10 more in Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Remote (100% remote, from anywhere with a stable internet connection; no office attendance required)
- **Level:** Not specified (2+ years of professional data engineering experience required)
- **Salary:** 1,000 – 2,500 USD per month (25 – 62 million VND per month), depending on experience and skills
- **Work model:** Full-time, fully remote, employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) with a full local employment contract and local statutory benefits. Core hours are 10:00 – 19:00 Japan time (8:00 – 17:00 Vietnam time), with flextime outside core hours. No change of work location is required.

## Responsibilities

**Data collection and ingestion**
- Design and implement large-scale web scraping systems that reliably extract structured data from many different sources.
- Build API integration pipelines for partner data sources, including schema validation and anomaly detection.
- Design real-time ingestion pipelines for daily updates, with a target latency of under one minute.
- Design and maintain crawling workflows that cover the websites of every company and continuously track changes to them.

**Transformation and data quality**
- Build and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into SalesNow's unified schema.
- Define data quality SLAs (accuracy, completeness, freshness) and build monitoring dashboards and alerts that detect issues before customers do.
- Implement large-scale entity resolution and deduplication, matching company records across sources that use different formats, naming conventions, and identifiers.
- Address the job-closure detection problem: determine whether a job posting is still open or has closed. Closure logic currently spans three systems with different behavior by source. Some sources do not show closure status on listing pages, so diff-based comparison can wrongly mark postings as closed when a crawl fails temporarily.

**Infrastructure and orchestration**
- Orchestrate complex Airflow DAGs across collection, transformation, enrichment, and distribution of data.
- Optimize PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch

## Company

MBBANK is a Vietnamese commercial bank. This role is in its Digital Banking division, which supports the integration of partner services with the bank's systems.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi
- **Level:** Specialist (Chuyên viên)

## Responsibilities

**I. Partner Service Integration Support**

- Receive partner information, service scope, integration plans, and points of contact.
- Guide partners on integration documentation, APIs, connection procedures, security requirements, and the bank's technical and business conditions.
- Prepare or coordinate the creation of test data, ensuring that data is complete, valid, and suitable before it is provided.
- Guide partners through implementation steps, input/output requirements, and required documentation; help resolve obstacles and coordinate with stakeholders to respond promptly.
- Manage test data to ensure it is used in the correct environment and complies with security regulations, and do not use real customer data without approval.

**II. Integration Progress, Testing, and Acceptance Management**

- Create and update integration plans for each partner or service; track progress, identify delayed tasks, their causes, and related responsibilities.
- Consolidate progress reports, risks, and bottlenecks, and propose solutions.
- Analyze test data requirements and prepare data covering success flows, exception cases, and boundary conditions.
- Monitor the execution of test scenarios; record results, errors found, remediation plans, and coordinate re-testing after fixes.
- Review acceptance results and documentation; coordinate confirmation that conditions are met before recommending go-live.

**III. Go-Live Checklist, Deployment, and Post-Deployment Monitoring**

- Coordinate the go-live plan with partners and related units, including timing, on-duty personnel, tasks, and communication arrangements.
- Review the pre-go-live checklist: acceptance results, production configuration, access rights, connectivity, security controls, and required approvals.
- Coordinate post-go-live checks, confirm the service operates within the approved scope, and hand it over to the operations unit.
- Ensure production deployment complies with the bank's approval process, change control, and information security requirements.
- Monitor the service after go-live; receive and coordinate the handling of issues that arise.
- Update progress reports, completion rates, causes of delays, and remediation plans.
- Maintain complete and compliant records of integration documentation, test results, acceptance minutes, go-live checklists, and related files.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- University degree or higher in IT, Information Systems, Finance and Banking, Economics, or a related field.
- 1–3 years of experience in system/API integration, technology deployment, project management, partner support, or digital product operations.
- Preferred: experience at a bank, fintech, payment intermediary, or banking technology company; understanding of or experience with banking operations, payments, API Banking, Open Banking/BaaS, testing, and service deployment.
- Experience in testing, acceptance, and production deployment; preference for candidates who have worked as a Tester/QA, prepared test data, or performed API testing.
- Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English and use office software for planning, tracking, and reporting.
- Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, system integration flows, Test/UAT/Production environments, and error handling.
- Testing mindset, with the ability to create and manage test cases and test data; preference for candidates with experience testing APIs using Postman or equivalent tools.
- Careful, proactive, and responsible in managing documentation, reporting, and task tracking.

## Benefits

- **Bonuses:** Holiday and Tết bonuses; performance bonuses linked to individual performance and business results.
- **Health insurance:** Healthcare coverage for employees and their dependents, with additional privileges.
- **Travel:** Annual domestic and international travel or retreat programs.
- **Life milestones:** Support for important moments, such as birthday leave and wedding gifts.
- **Employee engagement:** Birthday gifts, Lunar New Year gifts, and seniority-based recognition.
- **Financial services:** Advisory and financial support, and access to the group's personal financial and insurance products.
- **Career development:** Clear career progression paths and development opportunities across the bank's professional groups.

  - Automation and workflow integration

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Clear communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred**

title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN WECARE GROUP
description:
## Company

WeCare Group (CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN WECARE GROUP) is a B2B distributor of industrial supplies in Vietnam. It sells industrial hardware and consumables, including fasteners, welding materials, adhesives, packaging film, pipes and fittings, and metal hardware, from a catalog of thousands of SKUs. Its customers are hardware shops nationwide and manufacturing factories. The company purchases from suppliers, holds its own inventory, and delivers to business customers across the country. It processes over 100,000 orders per month.

The company is rebuilding its core ERP platform from a legacy low-code stack to a cloud-native system on Google Cloud Platform.

## Details

- **Location:** Lô 14-16-18-20, Đường số 36, Phường Bình Phú, TP. Hồ Chí Minh (Ho Chi Minh City)
- **Level:** Senior / Team Lead / Senior Specialist; 5+ years of experience
- **Work model:** On-site, with 1 work-from-home day per month
- **Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00; Saturday, 08:00 to 12:00

## Responsibilities

This is a foundational hire for Phase 1 of the ERP rebuild. You will own the entire cloud foundation and co-architect the engineering harness (CI/CD, automated verification gates, and AI-assisted delivery pipelines) alongside the R&D Lead. The platform decisions you make will shape the system architecture for years to come.

- Design and manage the GCP landing zone, project structure, VPC, IAM (following the least-privilege principle), and multi-tier environments.
- Own end-to-end infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ensuring 100% reproducibility with zero manual or hand-configured setups.
- Build and optimize GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, integrated with rigorous verification gates to maintain high code quality at AI-accelerated delivery speeds.
- Manage Cloud SQL, including provisioning, HA/DR, automated backups, and migration safety. Establish Cloud Run deployment patterns with Pub/Sub messaging.
- Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLA/SLO tracking using GCP-native tools and/or Datadog.
- Establish the security baseline, including RBAC, Secret Manager integration, and audit logging.

**3D animation**

**Video editing and motion graphics**

**AI-assisted production**

## Company

- **Seniority/Level:** Senior specialist (3–5 years of experience)

**a. Product research and development**

- Coordinate with business, IT, operations, marketing, risk, and compliance units to build, test, and launch products to market.

**b. Product lifecycle management**
- Monitor performance, usage rates, and customer feedback to recommend appropriate product adjustments.

- Collect and consolidate feedback from customers and branches, and propose periodic improvements.

**Education**
- University degree or higher in Finance–Banking, Economics, Information Technology, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

**Experience**

- Preference for candidates who have directly participated in developing or managing Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, eKYC, QR Pay, card, or e-wallet products.

**Knowledge and skills**
- Understanding of retail banking operations, electronic payments, transaction security, and legal compliance.
- Product mindset, with the ability to analyze customer and market data.
- Proficiency in planning, writing product proposals, project management, and coordinating across multiple departments.
- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills; logical, creative, and customer-focused thinking.
- Proficiency in MS Office, advanced Excel, and PowerPoint. SQL, Jira, Confluence, or Power BI is a plus.
- English: ability to read specialized documents and communicate at a basic level or higher.

## Benefits

- Attractive compensation package
- Comprehensive welfare policies
- Professional, dynamic, and cohesive work environment
- Clear career development path
- Opportunities for networking, team bonding, and comprehensive development

- **Level:** Specialist (Chuyên viên)

**Main purpose of the role**

- Ensure the technical quality of the project by overseeing the design and construction of electrical, water, HVAC, and fire protection and prevention (PCCC) systems in line with technical standards, contributing to the quality and long-term durability of the works.
- Ensure compliance with legal requirements and technical regulations:
  - MEP and fire protection systems must comply with construction codes and fire safety regulations, so the works can be licensed, accepted, and put into use.
- Propose design and construction solutions that reduce investment and operating costs while maintaining functionality and a high level of safety.

**1. Design and technical work**

- Take part in designing and reviewing drawings for MEP systems (electrical, water, and air conditioning/ventilation) and fire protection systems (fire water supply and drainage, fire alarm, automatic fire suppression, smoke extraction, and similar).
- Propose technical solutions that are appropriate, cost-effective, and efficient during design and construction.

**2. Construction and supervision**

- Supervise construction on site, ensuring the contractor follows the design, technical standards, and schedule.
- Inspect and accept materials and equipment installed in the MEP and fire protection systems.
- Take part in internal acceptance and in acceptance with the supervision consultant, the investor, and relevant authorities.

**3. Documentation and legal compliance**

- Support the preparation of fire protection permit applications and coordinate inspection and acceptance with the Fire Police (Cảnh sát PCCC).
- Draft and review technical documents, as-built drawings, and operation and maintenance documentation.

**4. Coordination and contractor management**

- Work with subcontractors, suppliers, and supervision consultants to resolve technical issues as they arise.
- Attend technical meetings and on-site coordination meetings.

**5. Other duties**

- Perform other tasks assigned by management.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Education**

- University degree in a relevant field, such as electrical and mechanical engineering, refrigeration and HVAC, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, or electrical and electronic engineering.
- Holds a Class I supervision certificate for civil and technical infrastructure works issued by the Ministry of Construction.

**Experience**

- Experience constructing high-rise buildings and solar or wind power projects.
- At least 3 to 5 years of experience supervising MEP works.

**Technical skills**

- Construction supervision skills.
- Knowledge of Vietnamese (TCVN) and international standards such as NFPA, ASHRAE, and IEC.
- Strong ability to read technical drawings, manage time, communicate, and handle difficult situations.
- Understanding of design standards and Vietnamese and international codes relevant to MEP and fire protection.
- Proficient in AutoCAD, Revit, MS Office, and system design software (e.g., Ductsize, HAP, Dialux).

**Soft skills**

- Able to work effectively under high pressure.
- Works well in a team.

**Other qualities**

- Direct and honest in work.
- Continuously learns new skills to work faster and produce higher-quality results.

## Company

## Responsibilities

- **24/7 grid supervision and operation:** Monitor the operating status of the power grid through SCADA, DMS, or other dedicated monitoring software, combined with direct on-site observation, to assess whether the grid can operate safely and to identify potential incidents.
- **Incident handling and maintenance:** Quickly detect and resolve grid incidents such as short circuits, overloads, and phase loss, and coordinate with technical teams to repair equipment and restore power.
- **Operation planning:** Analyze load demand and develop appropriate power switching plans (energizing and de-energizing) to optimize performance and ensure safety.
- **Coordination with relevant parties:** Work with the Department of Industry and Trade, the local electricity utility (Điện lực), dispatch units, maintenance teams, and customers to keep the grid operating safely and continuously, and handle technical situations promptly.
- **Reporting and data analysis:** Collect operational data, evaluate grid performance, and propose improvement solutions.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- College or university degree in Power Systems, Industrial Electrical Engineering, Electric Power Engineering, or an equivalent field.
- At least 2–3 years of experience operating medium- and high-voltage grids; direct experience operating a 110kV substation is preferred.
- Solid understanding of operating procedures for transformer substations, ATS (automatic transfer switches), RMU (ring main units), protection relays, SCADA/DMS, and electrical safety standards.
- Ability to identify and handle grid incidents such as phase loss, overload, ground faults, and equipment fires or explosions.
- Thorough knowledge of power shutdown, energizing, load transfer procedures, and developing operation plans.
- Good health, willingness to work 24/7 shifts, and quick reaction in emergencies.
- Preferred: electrical safety certification, 110kV substation operation certification, and experience at a power company or electrical contractor.
- Personal qualities: careful, disciplined, able to work under high pressure, and works well in teams and coordinates effectively with technical units.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary
- 13th-month salary bonus and various benefit packages
- Comprehensive welfare policies for individuals and their families
- In-depth training programs (including e-learning)
- Global work environment with nearly 30 branches and representative offices
- Grade A office space
- Diversity and inclusion (D&I) work culture

**2. Asset sales**
- **2.1. Handling/selling mortgaged assets seized by or handed over to VPBank through VPBank-run auctions, in accordance with the law:**
  - Receive requests and take over asset files for auction from the debt resolution units assigned by the Planning and Integration Department (Phòng KHTH), in order to carry out forced sale of assets seized under Resolution 42.
  - Submit internal valuation requests, engage independent valuers, and accompany valuation staff on site inspections.

  - Run marketing, post listings, search for buyers, and conduct tele-sales. Filter asset lists and send them to investment partners and brokers in related fields.
  - Take prospective buyers to view assets, advise them, and guide them through purchasing auction documents and paying deposits.
  - Support buyers who win auctions through contract signing.
- **2.2. Selling mortgaged assets through civil judgment enforcement auctions (Thi hành án, THA):**
  - Meet with enforcement officers (CHV) to discuss sale options and compulsory asset enforcement.
  - Run marketing, post listings, search for buyers, and conduct tele-sales. Filter asset lists and send them to investment partners and brokers in related fields.
  - Take buyers to view assets, advise them, and resolve issues among the parties involved (buyers, sellers, enforcement officers, asset owners, and the enforcement auction sale procedures).
  - Coordinate with debt resolution officers (XLN) and auction companies to help customers purchase auction files and pay deposits.
  - Support buyers who win auctions through contract signing.
  - Coordinate with debt resolution officers, THA, enforcement officers, and winning buyers to develop a plan and carry out asset handover or compulsory enforcement.

- Oversee debt resolution officers in recording debt repayment and processing the release of mortgages so the asset can be handed over to the customer.
- Check and confirm all costs incurred during asset handling, so that debt recovery, advance repayments, and asset-handling expenses are fully and punctually settled.
- Update the system with complete records of the asset sale process.
- Archive files completely and systematically according to the checklist.
- Work with competent state agencies to complete post-sale ownership transfer registration, so customers can quickly and lawfully complete the related procedures for purchased assets.

**4. Other duties and instructions from management**
- Submit periodic reports and operational reports through the Tethys software.
- Perform other tasks assigned by management.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Planning and organizational skills, with the ability to execute plans.
- Results management skills.
- Communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills.
- Time management skills.
- Risk management skills.
- Relationship building and development skills.

## Company

Easia Travel (Công Ty Easia Travel) is a travel company based in Hanoi, Vietnam. It builds Koob, a travel platform that connects hotel contracts, supplier availability, and pricing to partners such as DMCs and tour operators through a partner API and back-office tools.

## Details

- **Location:** Hà Nội (Hanoi), Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Senior, experienced individual contributor (non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable (Thương lượng)

## Responsibilities

- Build features for the hotel contract and availability engine, covering seasons, rates, allotments, promotions, and cancellation rules.
- Write and maintain supplier connections (SOAP and REST) and the partner API.
- Build screens in the React back office for DMCs and tour operators.
- Write functional tests for every change and every bug fix.
- Monitor production in Datadog and fix issues, together with the rest of the team.
- Review merge requests, guide design decisions, and keep the codebase clean as the product grows.

**Problems you will work on:**

- **AI inside the platform:** Make Koob easier to use through AI. The MCP server already lets AI agents search hotels, load contracts, and book. Upcoming work includes RAG over hotel and destination content, and assistants that help DMCs and tour operators work faster.
- **Fast availability across suppliers:** Room searches fan out to several hotel suppliers and internal contracts. Speed is maintained with a shared Redis cache and an Elasticsearch read model that must stay in sync with PostgreSQL.
- **A pricing engine with real rules:** Seasons, weekday rules, promotions, extra beds, and cancellation rules combine into a single price, rounded to 2 decimal places and identical on every path.
- **Supplier connections:** SOAP and REST integrations where each supplier structures its data differently. Data is cleaned and validated where it enters the system.
- **A versioned partner API:** Three live API versions that partners depend on.
- **Reliable background work:** Imports, syncs, and emails run as jobs on Cloud Tasks, with retries and alerts on failure.

**Must have:**

- Software design skills: able to shape data models, API contracts, and module boundaries that remain sound a year later.
- UI/UX design skills: the team has no dedicated designer, so the candidate designs clear, usable screens independently, from a rough idea to a finished page.
- 5+ years of experience building full-stack web applications in production with TypeScript and Node.js or similar technologies.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Hands-on React experience.
- Writes tests without being asked.
- Good written and spoken English, as the team works with international companies.

**Nice to have:**

- Experience building LLM features, such as MCP servers, RAG, embeddings, prompt design, and evaluation.
- Travel industry experience, such as hotel contracts, bed banks, GDS, or channel managers.
- NestJS, and an ORM such as MikroORM or TypeORM.
- Elasticsearch knowledge.
- Google Cloud, Terraform, and Datadog experience.

## Benefits

- Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
- Personal accident and health insurance, 24/24 coverage (PTI).
- Travel opportunity: Motivation Trip.

- Define the overall electrical and embedded system architecture, ensuring ultra-low-latency, highly deterministic communication networks (e.g., EtherCAT, CAN FD) between the surgeon console, the robotic arms on the patient cart, and the multi-axis manipulators inside the body.
- Design custom FPGA logic and microcontroller firmware for high-frequency motor control loops, real-time sensor data acquisition, and hardware-accelerated safety monitoring.
- Design hardware-level safety features, redundancy mechanisms, electrical isolation, and fail-safe watchdog systems optimized for real-time robotic actuation and surgical safety.
- Work closely with mechanical and algorithm/control teams to integrate high-precision sensors (absolute and relative encoders, multi-degree-of-freedom force/torque sensors) and actuators (BLDC motors, servos) into compact electromechanical assemblies.
- Manage the full hardware lifecycle, from schematic design and rapid prototyping through board bring-up, rigorous EMI/EMC testing, thermal optimization, and transfer to volume manufacturing.
- Maintain careful records and documentation of electrical, FPGA, and embedded design contributions to create, maintain, and protect the company's intellectual property portfolio.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- A Master's degree, or a Bachelor's/Engineer's degree with distinction, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience developing complex hardware and embedded systems for robotics or motion control. Alternatively, a PhD with 2+ years of relevant experience.
- Broad knowledge of mixed-signal circuit design, high-speed digital design, power electronics (custom motor drive circuits), and advanced PCB layout. Excellent ability to resolve EMI/EMC and signal integrity issues in dense electromechanical assemblies.
- Proficiency in modern C/C++ for bare-metal and RTOS environments (FreeRTOS, QNX). Hands-on experience with ARM Cortex microcontrollers (e.g., STM32) and in-depth FPGA knowledge (Verilog/VHDL) for high-speed data processing and motor commutation.
- Practical experience developing low-level drivers and using high-speed deterministic protocols (EtherCAT, CAN FD, SPI, I2C, UART).
- Strong debugging skills using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers to solve complex hardware-software-mechanical communication issues.
- English proficiency is a major advantage (IELTS 6.5).
- Comprehensive experience across the product development lifecycle for Class II/III medical devices, including design, implementation, verification, validation (V&V), and management of the Design History File (DHF).
- Familiarity with medical safety and performance standards, specifically IEC 60601-1 (electrical safety), IEC 60601-1-2 (EMC), and IEC 62304 (medical device software lifecycle).
- Practical experience designing embedded electronics to drive servo and BLDC motors and read high-resolution optical or magnetic encoders in extremely space-constrained environments.
- Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines for embedded targets, and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulators for validating motion control.

## Benefits

- Bonus according to company policy

## Company

WowSuite Software runs direct-response ecommerce, lead-generation, subscription, and telehealth funnels, with most traffic coming from paid campaigns on Meta, Taboola, and Outbrain. Its funnels include presell pages, index pages, checkouts, and upsells, and most of its traffic is mobile.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Experienced (non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

WowSuite is hiring a hands-on CRO Specialist to improve the commercial performance of its ecommerce, lead-generation, subscription, and telehealth funnels.

This is not a basic "button color" CRO role or a pure design role. You will use data, customer behavior, AI, and experimentation to identify where funnels lose money, determine why, and decide what to test next.

This is an AI-first role. AI should be part of your normal workflow for research, analytics, testing, QA, and reporting. Copy and design skills are a strong bonus but not the main requirement.

**Main goal:** Increase profitable revenue from the traffic the company already has. Performance is measured by commercial results, not activity.

### What You Will Own

- Analyze the full funnel from traffic source through landing page, checkout, payment, upsells, and retention.
- Identify the highest-value conversion and economic constraints using data.
- Build and prioritize a CRO testing backlog based on expected commercial impact.
- Design and analyze structured A/B tests with clear hypotheses, primary metrics, and guardrails.
- Improve CVR, revenue per visitor/click, AOV, payment completion, upsell rate, and profitability.
- Segment performance by traffic source, campaign, device, geography, and funnel path.
- Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, reviews, support data, and customer research to understand behavior.
- Turn findings into specific test recommendations for offers, copy, UX, page structure, checkout, proof, and payment flows.
- Give clear briefs to designers, copywriters, and developers, and review execution against the CRO hypothesis.
- Use AI for research, analysis, SQL/formulas, test ideas, variants, and reporting.
- QA tests across mobile, desktop, tracking, pricing, checkout, and payment.
- Clearly report what was tested, why, the result, economic impact, decision, and next test.
- Move winners live quickly.

### How We Work

- Profit before vanity metrics.
- Funnel before page.
- Diagnosis before ideas.

title: Data Modeler/ Semantic Analyst
company: Japfa Comfeed Vietnam Ltd
description:
## Company

Japfa Comfeed Vietnam Ltd is a food and agribusiness company operating in animal feed, farming, and food production in Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Vĩnh Phúc
- **Level:** Manager
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

**Purpose of the role**

- Build and maintain a single source of truth for all organizational metrics, KPIs, and business definitions.
- Design analytical data models and a semantic layer that serve both BI dashboards and AI agents.
- Ensure each KPI and metric has one standard, consistent definition that is shared across all divisions.
- Coordinate data governance, including metadata, change control, and the report catalog for the whole team.

**Main tasks**

1. **KPI dictionary and business definitions**
   - Collect and consolidate all KPIs and metrics in use across divisions.
   - Identify conflicts, where the same KPI is calculated differently by different divisions, and work with the Leader to reach agreement.
   - Write standard semantic definitions covering name, formula, grain, filter conditions, and owner.
   - Manage change control so that every change to a definition follows the process: request, review, approve, publish.

2. **Semantic layer and data modeling**
   - Design analytical data models using dimensional modeling (star schema).
   - Build conformed dimensions (Product, Customer, Channel, Time, Organizational Hierarchy) shared across divisions.
   - Implement the semantic layer on Snowflake (views, materialized views).
   - Optimize models for query performance (pre-aggregation, clustering).

3. **Data governance and coordination**
   - Manage the report catalog by consolidating all active reports and dashboards.
   - Review and approve data models before production deployment.
   - Work with business analysts (BA) across divisions to keep data definitions consistent.
   - Support the Leader in cross-division alignment meetings.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Economics, Business Administration, or an equivalent field.
- At least 2 years of experience in data modeling, BI, or data governance.
- Proficiency in SQL, including views, CTEs, analytical functions, and materialized views.
- Intermediate or higher proficiency in dimensional modeling: star schema, snowflake schema, and conformed dimensions.
- Business acumen with an understanding of key business KPIs in sales, production, costing, and inventory.
- Intermediate or higher proficiency in Snowflake: writing views and materialized views, data sharing, and access control.
- Basic or higher understanding of BI tools and how they use data models (e.g., Qlik).
- Basic or higher understanding of data governance: metadata, lineage, data ownership, and change control.
- Preferred, not required: experience with dbt (semantic/metrics layer), knowledge of data for AI/ML, and experience with data catalog tools.
- Preferred, not required: experience in the feed, farm, or food industry.

**Other requirements**

- Logical thinking and the ability to translate business concepts into accurate data models.
- Careful and patient attention to detail, with definitions precise down to each filter condition and grain level.
- Strong communication with both technical teams (data engineers, DE) and business teams (BPL).
- Ability to negotiate and lead discussions to reach agreement when stakeholders disagree on KPI definitions.
- Clear documentation habits and disciplined, up-to-date record keeping.
- Ability to read technical documentation in English and communicate in English.

## Benefits

- Health care
- 24-hour accident insurance
- Shuttle bus,

## Company

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City
- **Level:** Senior Specialist (experienced, non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

The role is responsible for (i) analyzing the credit card and unsecured lending portfolio and (ii) building reports on credit card and unsecured lending products, using data to recommend product and process improvements that increase the business performance of the division.

1. **Data Management and Optimization**
   - Develop, maintain, and update datamarts related to the unsecured loan and credit card portfolios accurately, completely, and on time to support analysis and reporting.
   - Verify the integrity, accuracy, and consistency of data used in analysis, from raw data sources through datamarts to final reports.

2. **Analysis of Credit Card and Unsecured Lending Portfolios**
   - Perform comprehensive analysis and monitoring of the credit card and unsecured lending portfolios to assess profitability, growth trends, and portfolio structure.
   - Evaluate portfolio balance, identify potential risks early, and establish appropriate early-warning mechanisms.
   - Provide in-depth analysis and recommendations to optimize portfolio performance and support sustainable growth aligned with the bank's risk appetite.
   - Propose adjustments to credit policies, appraisal criteria, and approval processes based on data insights to improve credit decision quality and business performance.

3. **Business Performance Analysis**
   - Evaluate the effectiveness of new customer acquisition campaigns, analyze factors affecting conversion rates, and recommend optimal distribution channels and acquisition strategies.
   - Conduct in-depth analysis of product usage behavior for unsecured loans and credit cards (e.g., transaction frequency, transaction value, spending categories, loan lifecycle) to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.
   - Build and apply predictive models (e.g., purchase propensity, response propensity, identification of customers likely to revolve debt) to identify and target high-potential customer segments for credit card and unsecured loan products, improving campaign effectiveness.

4. **Reporting and Regulatory Compliance**
   - Support the preparation and ensure that all reports related to unsecured lending and credit card activities are submitted accurately, completely, and on time to the State Bank of Vietnam and other regulatory authorities.
   - Support the development and maintenance of a periodic business performance reporting system (daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports) for stakeholders, providing clear visibility into the status of the loan and credit card portfolios.
   - Support the optimization of reporting processes through automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual errors.

5. **Attrition Prevention and Risk Management**
   - Develop predictive models for customer attrition and propose data-driven customer retention strategies.
   - Analyze data to identify potential fraud patterns related to credit card transactions and loan accounts.

6. Perform other tasks as assigned.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance-Banking, Business Administration, Information Technology, Statistics, Econometrics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
- Minimum years of experience in developing credit card and unsecured lending products at financial institutions, depending on level: 5 years (Director / Business Director), 3 years (Expert / Senior Specialist), 2 years (Principal Specialist), or 1 year (Specialist).
- Understanding of the retail customer market, customer needs, banking products and services, banking policies and regulations, and banking operations systems.
- Proficiency in SQL, Python, or equivalent tools. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
- Knowledge of machine learning and predictive models (propensity, churn, segmentation, etc.).
- Professional knowledge of P&L and of credit card and unsecured lending product portfolios.
- Strong strategic and creative thinking skills.
- Good communication and relationship-building skills.
- Fluent English.

## Benefits

- Bonus according to bank policy
- Healthcare benefits
- Employee insurance, social insurance, and health insurance
- Paid leave: 15 days per year

AIRR Labs is a Singapore-headquartered e-commerce enabler in Southeast Asia. It specializes in FMCG, beauty, and lifestyle brands on platforms such as TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada, offering services including content strategy, performance marketing, livestreaming, store operations, and fulfillment. The company operates across Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Singapore, with a technology hub in Vietnam.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior, experienced (non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

This is a senior, hands-on role to help build and shape the foundation of AIRR Labs' data platform. The role focuses on building systems from the ground up, solving ambiguous engineering problems, and designing scalable data architecture rather than only maintaining existing pipelines. You will work closely with software engineers and product teams to define data standards, improve platform reliability, and build a scalable data foundation that supports analytics and future AI-driven initiatives. As one of the first dedicated hires in this space, you will help set the direction for the data function.

Job scope:

- **40% Data Architecture:** Partner with product and software engineering teams to design scalable data models, define architecture standards, and ensure clean data flows from source to consumption.
- **50% Data Engineering:** Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines, write performant SQL and transformation logic, and maintain data quality across TB-scale datasets.
- **10% Infrastructure Reliability:** Monitor platform uptime, troubleshoot incidents, and keep the cloud data infrastructure healthy.

Key responsibilities:

- Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration workflows.
- Develop and optimize data warehouse architecture, data models, and SQL performance across large-scale datasets.
- Build reliable batch-processing systems and improve platform observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance.
- Define data standards, naming conventions, and best practices for the data platform.
- Collaborate with software engineers and stakeholders to solve complex data and system design challenges.
- Contribute to future AI and automation initiatives, such as intelligent inventory management and self-healing data pipelines.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or related fields.
- Strong experience building scalable data systems and pipelines from scratch.
- Strong SQL skills, with an understanding of data modeling, partitioning, and performance optimization.
- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3 and Lambda.
- Experience with analytical databases such as SingleStore, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Redshift, or similar.
- Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar technologies.
- Proficiency in Python or another scripting or programming language.
- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think in systems and make engineering trade-offs.
- High ownership and an independent working style, with curiosity toward emerging technologies and AI-enabled workflows.
- Key skills: AI/ML and data engineering, data-driven decision making, data governance, MySQL, data architecture.

## Benefits

- Health insurance (BIC) and periodic health check-ups.
- 12 days of paid annual leave, plus additional company recharge days.
- Laptop, monitor, and other work equipment provided as required by the role.

- Strong capability in performance monitoring, SQL tuning, indexing, execution-plan analysis, capacity planning, and troubleshooting.
- Good knowledge of database security, privileged access, encryption, auditing, data masking, vulnerability remediation, segregation of duties, and compliance controls.

## Responsibilities

**1. Building and operating continuous, automated security testing capability**
- Deploy and operate testing platforms and tools, including Burp Suite Professional/Enterprise, ZAP, Nuclei, and SAST/DAST/SCA/IAST.
- Integrate security testing into CI/CD pipelines (shift-left), and manage SBOMs and software supply chain risk.
- Research new CVEs, write proof-of-concept (PoC) and exploit code, develop internal tools (Python/Go), and automate testing workflows.
- Apply AI/LLM to speed up analysis and report writing, while controlling the risk of data leakage when using AI.
- Advise senior management on new technologies and application security solutions for units across the ecosystem.

**2. Penetration testing of Web applications, APIs, and AI-integrated applications**
- Conduct in-depth manual testing according to OWASP WSTG/ASVS, covering business logic flaws, IDOR/BOLA, race conditions, SSRF, deserialization, HTTP request smuggling, and client-side attacks.
- Test APIs (REST/GraphQL/gRPC/Webhook) according to the OWASP API Security Top 10, including authorization, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, JWT, SSO, and passwordless (passkey) authentication flows.
- Test AI/LLM-integrated and Agentic AI applications, covering prompt injection, data leakage through RAG, abuse of agent/tool privileges, and MCP connection controls.
- Provide proof of exploitation (PoC), rate risk using CVSS 4.0 linked to business impact, and perform retests to verify remediation (Remediation Verification).
- Coordinate with relevant teams to develop patching plans and re-assessments.

**3. Supporting Blue Team/SOC to strengthen defensive capability (Purple Team)**
- Convert attack scenarios into detection use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and measure detection and response capability.
- Advise on application defense architecture, including WAF/WAAP, API Gateways, bot and API abuse protection, and Zero Trust principles.
- Track the vulnerability remediation lifecycle (MTTR), and provide early warning of exposure risks on the internet-facing attack surface (EASM).

**4. Standardizing processes, methodology, and compliance**
- Draft and periodically review procedures, regulations, checklists, and testing report templates in both Vietnamese and English.
- Ensure testing activities comply with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, PCI DSS 4.0.1, NIST CSF 2.0, the Law on Cybersecurity, the Law on Personal Data Protection No. 91/2025/QH15, and applicable sector-specific regulations.
- Manage, back up, and upgrade the testing lab infrastructure, and strictly protect sensitive data generated during testing.

**5. Team management, resource coordination, and reporting**
- Assign work, supervise quality, and review all reports before release.
- Build team capability development roadmaps, training programs, and team performance evaluations.
- Manage independent testing contractors, Bug Bounty/VDP programs, and tool budgets.
- Report application risk dashboards and exposure levels to the executive board on a regular basis.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- University degree or higher in Information Technology or Information Security. Candidates from other majors may be considered if they demonstrate equivalent practical expertise (certifications, CVEs, Bug Bounty, or CTF experience).
- Professional English: ability to read technical documentation and write reports.
- More than 6 years of experience in IT/Information Security.
- More than 4 years

description:
## Company

Galaxy Digital Holdings Co., Ltd (GH) is a company based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. It operates mobile applications, including transactional apps with payment, eKYC (electronic know-your-customer identity verification), and digital signing features.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Senior (experienced, non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

**Overview**

- Perform in-depth penetration testing of Android and iOS mobile applications (native, Flutter, and React Native), including all backend APIs that support the applications.
- Carry out reverse engineering and dynamic analysis, including bypassing root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, and anti-tampering/RASP protections, to assess how well the application actually resists attack.
- Assess the security of critical mobile business flows: payments, eKYC and biometric authentication, digital signatures, tokenization, and storage of sensitive data on the device.
- Exploit and demonstrate vulnerabilities through controlled proof-of-concept (PoC) work, rank risks by business impact, and perform retests to verify remediation.
- Research new mobile attack techniques and malware; develop tools and automation scripts for continuous testing and integrate them into the application release process.
- Provide technical advice to mobile development teams on root causes and remediation options, and support the Blue Team/SOC in building the ability to detect attacks targeting mobile users.

**1. Android and iOS Mobile Application Penetration Testing**

- Test against OWASP MASVS/MASTG on both platforms, using static analysis (jadx, apktool, Ghidra/IDA, MobSF) and dynamic analysis (Frida, objection, r2frida, Burp Suite).
- Test on-device data storage: Keychain/Keystore, local databases, cache files, logs, backups, residual data in memory, and background screenshots.
- Test cryptographic mechanisms: weak algorithms, hard-coded keys in source code, unsafe key generation, incorrect use of IVs/salts, and key lifecycle management.
- Test inter-process communication and platform attack surfaces: deep links, App Links, Universal Links, intent redirection, exported components, custom URL schemes, WebView vulnerabilities, and JavaScript bridge issues.
- Assess application protection mechanisms: root/jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, anti-debugging, code obfuscation, RASP, Play Integrity API, and App Attest, determining in practice whether they can be bypassed.

**2. Backend API Testing and Critical Business Flows**

- Test the APIs supporting the mobile application against the OWASP API Security Top 10: BOLA/IDOR, authorization flaws, abuse of rate limits/quotas, and excessive data exposure.
- Test authentication and session management: OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT, refresh tokens, device binding, biometric authentication (BiometricPrompt/Face ID), and client-side bypass.
- Test payment and identity flows: tokenization, HCE/NFC, online transactions, and eKYC, including attempts to bypass liveness checks using photos, videos, and AI-generated content (deepfakes).
- Test mobile-specific business logic flaws: race conditions in transactions, client-side parameter tampering, request replay, and abuse of account recovery flows.

## Responsibilities

The Solution Consultant is responsible for the full project lifecycle for each client, from current-state assessment and solution design through system configuration, testing, and go-live handover. The role combines business analysis with data-design and platform-configuration expertise.

**2.1 Discovery and Current-State Analysis (Phase 1)**
- Interview client departments (Sales, Warehouse/Logistics, Accounting, Marketing, Customer Service) to document current processes and pain points.
- Produce an analysis of the existing systems and their limitations.
- Determine digitization priorities and the client's success criteria.
- Prepare a Solution Proposal using the company's standard template.

**2.2 Solution Design and Data Architecture (Phase 2)**
- Design Objects (equivalent to database schema design): define entities and relationships.
- Design Lookups (Normal/Dependency) and select appropriate field types from more than 20 field types.
- Design BPMN processes: determine flow types (Triggered, Manual, Scheduled, Sequence), and map nodes and conditional branches.
- Design the permission matrix: roles, CRUD rights per Object, and data-security rules.
- Prepare a detailed design document for client sign-off before configuration begins.

**2.3 Configuration and System Setup (Phase 3)**
- Create Objects, configure Fields, and use the drag-and-drop Layout Builder for create forms and view/edit forms.
- Set up UI Rules (show/hide fields based on conditions), Transition Rules (status changes), and Duplicate Rules (duplicate detection).
- Enable Field Change History for key status fields (e.g., Lead status, Opportunity stage, Order status, Ticket status).
- Configure BPMN workflows: Triggered Flows (run automatically when a record changes), Manual Flows (request forms), and Scheduled Flows (run on a schedule).
- Set up Assignment Rules, document templates, automatic notifications, and email integration.
- Where the project requires it, connect Omnichannel channels (Facebook, Zalo, TikTok, Shopee) and configure Service features (call center, IVR, ACD).

The role is an in-depth research position focused on the security of 2G/3G/4G/5G mobile telecommunications networks, including protocol security, software-defined radio (SDR), SIM/eSIM, baseband, the Radio Access Network (RAN), and the Core Network.

- Conduct in-depth security research on 2G/3G/4G/5G mobile telecommunications networks, focusing on network architecture, signaling protocols, the radio access network, and the core network.
- Analyze protocols and components such as GSM, UMTS, LTE, 5G NR, SS7, Diameter, GTP, SIP/IMS, NAS, RRC, and related protocols.

- Analyze attack techniques such as signaling abuse, downgrade attacks, protocol confusion, rogue base stations, paging/identity exposure, and other vulnerability types specific to mobile networks.
- Build proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits, fuzzing frameworks, protocol analyzers, and automation tools to support telecommunications security research.
- Monitor new vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and research related to 4G/5G/6G.

description:
## Company

Square Group is a Vietnamese marketing communications group, operated by Công Ty Cổ Phần Truyền Thông Square. It consists of eight member agencies spanning event, activation, production, and digital communication.

## Details

- **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
- **Level:** Experienced (non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a hands-on, business-facing builder working at the intersection of AI and the agency business. The role is embedded directly with the teams of Square Group's member companies to understand how work is actually done, identify where AI can create measurable value, and rapidly design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions (agents, automated workflows, integrations, and internal tools) into daily operations. The FDE combines the skills of an engineer, a solution consultant, and a project lead: translating business pain points into working prototypes within days, taking proven solutions to production, driving user adoption, and turning successful one-off solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.

**1. Embed with Agency Teams and Discover Use Cases**
- Work side by side with account, creative, production, finance, and back-office teams of member companies to map workflows and identify high-impact AI opportunities.
- Define problem statements, success metrics, and expected ROI with business owners, and prioritize the use-case backlog.

**2. Build and Deploy AI Solutions**
- Rapidly prototype with LLMs, AI agents, automation/low-code tools, and custom code, then turn validated prototypes into reliable production solutions.
- Integrate AI into the tools teams already use (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, finance and project systems), with human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive outputs.

**3. Data and Integration**
- Structure and connect agency knowledge and data (rate cards, quotations, case studies, supplier lists, SOPs) via APIs, connectors, and scripts, ensuring data confidentiality.

**4. Governance and Security**
- Work closely with Group IT to ensure every solution complies with the Group information security policy and personal data protection regulations (access control, data classification, approved tools).
- Document each production solution and agree on clear ownership and maintenance arrangements before handover, avoiding unmanaged "shadow IT" tools.

**5. Adoption and Enablement**
- Onboard and train users, build AI champions in each agency, and communicate results clearly to management and staff.

**6. Measurement and Productization**
- Track the impact of each deployment against agreed KPIs and turn proven solutions into reusable assets for the whole Group.
- Indicative KPIs include the number of use cases taken to production per quarter, working hours saved, user adoption rate, and number of AI champions trained per member company.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Must-have**
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data/Business Analytics, Marketing/Communications, or equivalent practical experience.
- Minimum of 3–5 years' experience in a hands-on technical role (software/full-stack, data, automation, AI, or solution engineering), OR in a business/operations role with a proven track record of building automation and AI solutions.
- Proven portfolio of AI/automation solutions that were actually deployed and used by real users (links, demos, or case studies to be shared).
- Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (prompting, tool calling), Python or JavaScript, APIs, and at least one automation platform (n8n, Make, Apps Script, or similar).
- Good data skills (spreadsheets, SQL, data structuring) and working knowledge of Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365.
- Consulting mindset and strong stakeholder management: able to turn business processes into clear solutions and present ROI convincingly to C-level executives in a fast-paced agency environment.
- Ownership, speed, and curiosity about AI; high integrity and confidentiality; fluent Vietnamese and good English.

**Nice-to-have**
- Experience working in an agency (marcom, event, activation, production, or digital communication), in-house or client-facing. Understanding of the agency workflow (brief, pitch, quotation, production, execution, recap, billing, finance, and back-office operations) is highly valued.
- Experience with RAG, MCP, vector databases, or AI agents running in production

## Responsibilities

**Overview of the role**

- Advise on and analyze business processes, design solutions, and directly implement and operate the core modules of the SAP system (S/4HANA or SAP ECC 6.0), including MM (Materials Management/Procurement), SD (Sales and Distribution), PP (Production Planning), or FICO (Financial Accounting/Controlling).
- Ensure the system runs smoothly, optimize the supply chain, production, and finance processes, and fully meet the business requirements of the company and plant.

**Solution Analysis and Design (Business Blueprint & Design)**

- Work directly with department heads and business users (Key Users) to survey and analyze current business processes (As-Is) and propose standard SAP processes (To-Be).
- Prepare the Business Blueprint (BBP) documentation and detailed design documents (Functional Design / Functional Specification) for customization and enhancement requirements (RICEFW).
- Integrate cross-module data flows, connecting PP (Production) ↔ MM (Materials/Inventory) ↔ SD (Sales) ↔ FICO (recording costs, product cost, and revenue).

**Configuration and Testing**

- Perform customizing and configuration in the SAP S/4HANA or ECC system in accordance with the approved solution design.
- Coordinate with ABAP developers and the Technical Team to explain functional specifications, support testing of custom programs, and support solution acceptance.
- Develop test scripts and carry out unit testing, integration testing (IT) across modules, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).

**Go-Live and Operational Support (Data Migration & Support)**

- Coordinate data migration: format templates, cleanse master data, and load data into the system (using LTMC, LSMW, and BDC).
- Prepare user manuals and deliver training to end users (Key Users / End Users).
- Provide direct user support during Go-Live (cutover support) and handle incidents and change requests (CRs) during operations.
- Integrate SAP with satellite systems, including MES (manufacturing execution system), DMS (dealer management system), electronic invoicing (e-Invoice), and domestic banking systems.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Experience and Education**

- University degree in Information Technology, Management Information Systems (MIS), Accounting and Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related economics field.
- 3–5 years of experience as an SAP Functional consultant.
- Has participated in at least 1–2 full life-cycle implementation projects, from the start through Go-Live.
- Experience in Manufacturing, Automotive/Auto Parts, Retail, or multinational corporations is a plus.

**Technical Skills**

- In-depth knowledge of 1–2 core modules (MM/SD/PP or FICO) and a good understanding of integration flows with the other modules.
  - For Logistics (MM/SD/PP): strong knowledge of MRP, BOM, Routing, Purchase Orders, Sales Orders, Billing, and Inventory Management.
  - For FICO: strong knowledge of General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), Cost Center/Profit Center Accounting (CO-PCA/CCA), and Product Costing (CO-PC).
- Clear understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture (Business Partner, Universal Journal – ACDOCA, New Asset Accounting, etc.).
- Ability to read basic ABAP code to debug and trace errors is a major advantage.

**Soft Skills**

- Strong listening, analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions in business language users can understand.
- Good troubleshooting skills and ability to manage time and project pressure.

**Languages**

- Proficient English for reading specialized documents and working communication.

## Company

Western Environmental Pty Ltd. is an environmental remediation and technology company of about 40 people, headquartered in Perth, Australia. It operates across Australia and Southeast Asia, including dioxin and contaminated land projects in Vietnam with a local partner.

## Details

- **Seniority/Level:** Experienced (non-manager)

- **Employment arrangement:** The Vietnamese partner consultancy is the legal employer in Vietnam and handles pay, tax, and social security. Western Environmental directs the day-to-day work.

## Responsibilities

This is a hands-on, first-AI-hire role. You will be the only person doing this work, reporting to a company director in Perth, and you will build it yourself.

**Phase 1: Fix the company's own systems**
- Automate laboratory data and field record handling, which currently takes a week of manual work before anyone can analyse the data.
- Make several thousand technical documents, standards, and past reports searchable, so that the same questions do not get answered from scratch each time.
- Support regulatory reporting, where the format is rigid but the content is not and drafting consumes senior staff's time.

**Phase 2: Get the wider company using what you build**
- Drive adoption among about 40 staff, most of whom are technical but not software specialists, some of whom are sceptical. The tools must be good enough that people choose to use them.
- Put sensible guardrails around client and project data so staff can use the tools safely.

**Phase 3: Build capability within the business**
- Develop two engineers who want to move into AI work. This is part of the role.
- Remain the person who designs and builds. This is not a step toward managing a team.

**Internal first, then external**
- Some of what you build is expected to become commercial in its own right. The intention is real, but the detail is not yet defined.
- Communicate in writing to engineers and scientists in Australia, explaining the work and the decisions behind it.
- Travel to Perth once or twice in the first year, including time in the field, to understand how the business operates.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- Experience building LLM-based systems that other people use, such as retrieval, agentic workflows, tool use, and evaluation. Prototypes that never left a laptop do not count.
- Strong Python skills.
- Fluent English, written and spoken, for technical discussion with non-developers and for detailed written explanations to engineers and scientists in Australia.
- Curiosity, willingness to adopt better tools, and comfort working in the open when the answer is not yet known.
- Ability to explain a decision clearly, including one that turned out to be wrong.
- Around four to eight years of experience is typical,

## Company

G-Group is a Vietnamese technology group. The company's AI security research team works on the security of AI/ML systems, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents.

## Details

- **Location:** Hanoi, Vietnam
- **Level:** Experienced (non-manager)
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities

**Role objective:** Research the risks, attack techniques, and security evaluation methods for AI/ML, LLMs, RAG, and AI agents, and build proofs of concept (PoCs), benchmarks, and AI red-teaming tools.

- Research risks and attack techniques against AI/ML systems, LLMs, and AI agents.
- Study attack forms including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data poisoning, model extraction, model inversion, and adversarial attacks.
- Evaluate the security of LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, MCP/tool integrations, and other systems that use AI.
- Investigate how weaknesses can be exploited when AI interacts with files, APIs, databases, browsers, and external systems.
- Build PoCs, benchmarks, attack frameworks, and automated testing tools for AI red teaming.
- Research the security of the AI supply chain, including models, datasets, plugins, dependencies, model serialization, and inference infrastructure.
- Track new AI security research and test its practical applicability.
- Propose and develop methods and solutions for protecting AI systems.

**Role focus:** Conduct in-depth research on security technologies, discover new attack surfaces and vulnerabilities, develop PoCs, and build core technologies that can be turned into products or solutions for safety and cybersecurity.

## Requirements / Qualifications

**Required:**

- Strong foundational knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs.
- Strong Python programming skills.
- Understanding of LLM and Transformer architecture, embeddings, and RAG.
- Knowledge of application security, web security, or offensive security.
- Ability to read research papers, reproduce research results, and build PoCs.

**Preferred:**

- Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
- Experience with LLM red teaming or AI security assessments.
- Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM/GenAI Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or equivalent frameworks.
- Research, papers, or CVEs related to AI security.
- Experience deploying or testing AI agents or MCP.

**General requirements for a security researcher:**

- A research-oriented mindset, with a drive to understand underlying principles rather than only using existing tools.
- Ability to independently research a new topic, build test environments, and verify hypotheses.
- Ability to write PoCs, tools, and scripts for research.
- Strong reading comprehension of technical English documentation.
- Ability to write reports and present research findings.
- Priority given to candidates with CVEs, papers, technical blogs, GitHub projects, CTF achievements, or vulnerability disclosures.
- A willingness to share knowledge and collaborate with researchers from other domains.
- Adherence to responsible disclosure principles, applicable laws and regulations, and approved research scope.

## Benefits

- Bonus scheme, insurance, and leave entitlements in accordance with company policy and Vietnamese law.
- Team-building activities, a year-end gala, birthday celebrations, and holiday events.

This is a hands-on software engineering role with a broad scope. You will work across the systems CE depends on, including CRM, collaboration tools, data warehousing and reporting, building integrations that remove manual steps and using AI tooling such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot as part of how you build. You will own your deliverables end to end, from requirements through to running them in production, and work directly with the people who use them.

This is applied engineering, not machine learning research or model development. You will build software that uses AI tooling and LLM APIs to solve practical problems for the support, retention and operations teams, including integrations, automation, agents and internal applications, rather than training or tuning models.

**Making Existing Tooling Production-Ready**

**Integration & Data**

- **Professional expertise:**

- **Communication and documentation:**

- **Personality and behavior:**

## Company

## Details
- **Location:** Hồ Chí Minh City, Vietnam
- **Seniority/Level:** Manager
- **Salary:** Negotiable

## Responsibilities
Lead and oversee UOA Vietnam's corporate IT strategy and operations, ensuring a secure, reliable, resilient and cost-effective IT environment that supports business objectives and organisational growth. The IT Manager is responsible for IT planning, policies, budgeting, cybersecurity, risk management, vendor oversight and coordination with Group IT, while ensuring IT readiness for new office buildings and company premises.

### 1. Business Alignment and IT Planning
- Identify business needs and translate them into appropriate technology solutions, considering business value, risk, compliance, security, scalability and available resources.
- Develop and manage annual and multi-year IT plans, investment roadmaps and budgets; monitor expenditure, control costs and explain budget variances.
- Provide IT and security advice when evaluating, selecting and procuring technology solutions.
- Establish and maintain IT policies, standards, procedures and governance frameworks aligned with business needs and Group requirements.
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality and business processes through technology.

### 2. Infrastructure and Systems Management
- Ensure the availability, performance, reliability and security of IT infrastructure and services, including network, server, cloud and connectivity services.
- Oversee Microsoft 365, business and project applications, LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi networks, servers, endpoints, identity and access management, and local IT services.
- Manage IT system maintenance, upgrades, configuration and documentation, ensuring appropriate system and asset records are maintained.
- Oversee backup, disaster recovery and IT business continuity arrangements, ensuring recovery plans are documented, tested periodically and updated as required.
- Monitor infrastructure capacity and performance, identify potential issues and implement preventive and corrective measures.

### 3. User Support and IT Service Management
- Lead IT service delivery, user support, incident management, problem resolution and escalation to ensure timely and effective service.
- Establish and monitor service levels, response times and service quality against agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), where applicable.
- Handle major incidents, complex technical issues and escalations while delegating routine support activities to the IT Executive or external service providers.
- Identify recurring issues and implement improvements to reduce downtime and enhance the user experience.
- Maintain appropriate IT service documentation, procedures and user support guidelines.

### 4. Cybersecurity, Risk Management and Data Protection
- Oversee cybersecurity, identity and access controls, endpoint protection, data protection and information security in accordance with Group policies and applicable Vietnamese laws and regulations.
- Develop, implement and maintain local IT security policies, standards and procedures aligned with Group requirements.

## Company

Galaxy Technology Services Joint Stock Company (Công ty Cổ Phần Galaxy Technology Services) is a computer programming and software services company with 100–499 employees. It is based at the Galaxy Innovation Hub (GIHUB) in the Saigon Hi-Tech Park, District 9, Ho Chi Minh City.

## Details

- **Location:** Galaxy Innovation Hub (GIHUB), Saigon Hi-Tech Park (Khu CNC), District 9 (Tăng Nhơn Phú Ward, Thủ Đức City), Ho Chi Minh City
- **Position:** Manual QC Engineer (Japanese)
- **Seniority/Level:** Team Lead
- **Experience Required:** 3 years
- **Number of Openings:** 2
- **Employment Type:** Full-time
- **Salary:** Negotiable
- **Work Model:** On-site (in-office)

## Responsibilities

- Analyze requirements and clarify them to create plans, designs, and test cases in Japanese.
- Update test documents, including test plans, test cases, and test reports.
- Estimate testing activities.
- Open and verify bugs.
- Prepare test data and environments as needed to complete testing assignments.
- Open and verify reports, and track and monitor bugs/defects in the defect tracking system.
- Meet with customers daily to report status and issues and to verify requirements.
- Communicate directly with the team and customers about issues or problems.
- Work closely with the development team to develop, maintain, and execute manual test cases.
- Perform other duties as requested by superiors.

## Requirements / Qualifications

- College degree or higher in information technology, computer science, or a related field.
- At least 3 years of experience as a Software QA/QC Engineer (3–5 years preferred). Experience testing projects for the Japanese market is preferred.
- Proficient in developing test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test data, and in executing Functional, Integration, Regression, and UAT testing.
- Experience with API testing using Postman or Swagger, and understanding of SQL for backend data verification.
- Experience with automation and manual testing using Playwright is preferred. Performance testing experience is also preferred.
- Experience with backlog management and defect tracking tools.
- Experience using AI and AI testing tools to support test case generation, defect analysis, test automation, and overall QA/QC efficiency.
- Communicative English or Japanese is a plus.

## Benefits

- Working hours: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM, Monday to Friday.
- Full salary paid during the 2-month probation period.
- Annual salary review based on performance and contribution.
- 15 days of annual leave, with additional seniority leave as years of service increase.
- Year-end bonus and performance bonus based on business results.
- Social, health, and other insurance in accordance with the Labor Law, plus HDI health insurance.
- Company trips, year-end party, and sports clubs (football, badminton, running, pickleball, etc.).
- Monthly Happy Hours and celebrations for special occasions (International Women's Day, Vietnamese Women's Day, International Men's Day, Children's Day, Christmas, Lunar New Year, etc.).
- Mobility allowance for employees whose home-to-work distance is more than 15 km, and free internal parking.
- Birthday gift and holiday bonuses (New Year, Tết, 30/4–1/5, National Day).
- Welfare policies for union members (sickness, marriage, condolences, etc.).
- Work equipment provided according to company standards.
- Skytel phone SIM card with a limit of 100,000 VND per month.
